raw.title: Senior Data Engineer- Data & AI Platform (f/m/d)
raw.description:
Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d)


The Essentials

  • Team: Data & Analytics
  • Start date: As soon as possible
  • Location: Berlin / Genoa, hybrid — at least 60% in the office
  • Contract: Fixed-term
  • Working language: English
  • Salary band: Shared before your first interview


Your Impact

As Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d) at 7NXT Health Group, you’ll own our data platform end to end — from consuming backend events and APIs to the metrics a stakeholder reads. You’ll work closely with backend engineering, product and the business, and report to the Head of Data & Analytics. Your work directly impacts the data foundation on which ~900,000 subscribers across nine European markets rely every day.

We automate anything that repeats. Stakeholders used to ask us “is this number right?” — now they query governed data themselves through our MCP servers and a Slack agent. It’s the part of the job we’re proudest of, and you’ll keep shaping it as a product.


What you’ll drive

  • You design, build, test and maintain scalable, reliable and secure data pipelines and architectures
  • You keep integrations healthy as backend teams change their schemas, so the business keeps one version of each number it can defend
  • You ingest new data sources with Airflow and dbt, and lead migrations and KPI restatements when definitions change
  • You develop the governed semantic layer and data catalog across our brands — 7Mind, Gymondo and Buddyfit
  • You build Customer 360 and other cross-brand data products that help teams understand their users
  • You turn tracking knowledge into a tracking plan as code, so every event can be validated against a shared definition
  • You model data around the decisions the business makes, so every KPI traces back to a clear definition
  • You keep BigQuery fast and affordable as data volume grows
  • You collaborate closely with backend engineering, product and the business, and actively shape how we work


Our stack: BigQuery · GCS · dbt · Airflow · Python · SQL · GitHub Actions · Cloud Run · Rudderstack · GA4 · Firebase · Tableau · Claude Code · MCP servers · Slack bots


What defines you

Must-have

  • 4+ years building and running a production data warehouse in an industry context
  • Strong SQL and Python, with dbt and BigQuery in depth
  • Hands-on experience with GCP (BigQuery, GCS) or comparable cloud services
  • Airflow or a similar orchestrator; experience ingesting from application databases and third-party APIs
  • ETL/ELT concepts and experience writing tests that support data governance
  • At least one migration where the upstream system changed and the numbers still had to match
  • Git, CI/CD, and comfort with Bash and Linux scripting
  • Daily use of coding agents and opinions on how to make them reliable
  • Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences; fluent English

Nice-to-have

  • Master’s in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering)
  • LLM tools built on top of data — MCP servers, agents or bots
  • Subscription and payment data (Chargebee, Adyen, app receipts, vouchers)
  • Event tracking design and governance (GTM, tracking plans, schema validation)
  • Marketing attribution and CRM data (Braze, GA4, Adjust)
  • Container-based environments (Docker, Kubernetes) and Terraform
  • Tableau or comparable visualisation tools


People who make things happen

7NXT Health Group is Europe’s leading platform group for digital fitness and mental wellbeing. Through our brands Gymondo, 7Mind, Buddyfit and Preneo, we reach 20–30 million people per month across 9 European markets, helping them live healthier lives — physically and mentally. Our team of ~170 people grows organically, works at eye level, and genuinely practises what we preach.

We believe in trust over rigid structures, smart working over endless meetings — and that sustainability, inclusion and diversity aren’t buzzwords, they’re how we actually operate.


Everyone counts

We welcome what makes you unique.

At 7NXT Health Group we believe in diversity, openness and team spirit. No matter which gender you identify with, whether you have a disability, what your neurotype is, where you come from, what you believe in or how you love — you are welcome here.

Don’t meet all the criteria? No problem — if you’d like to help shape the future of health & wellbeing with us, we look forward to your application.

Need a more accessible process or have questions? Write to us — we’ll find a way.

Skip the cover letter. Show us one business process you automated or simplified — the one you’re most proud of. A repo, a script, a write-up or a few sentences are all fine. Tell us what it replaced and what you learned. We’ll go through it together in the interview.

title: Werkstudent Data & AI (m/w/d)
description: Wir sind BetterDoc, ein Digital-Health-Unternehmen mit über 200 Mitarbeitenden in Köln und Basel. Wir unterstützen Patienten mit schweren Erkrankungen und komplexen Diagnosen dabei, die passenden Spezialisten für ihr Anliegen zu finden. Dafür bündeln, strukturieren und analysieren wir qualitätsrelevante Daten aus dem Gesundheitswesen. Seit 2012 haben wir über 100.000 Patienten begleitet. Seit 2022 gehören wir zur Otto Group und arbeiten eng mit unserem Schwesterunternehmen Medgate zusammen, einem der führenden Telemedizin-Anbieter Europas. Du studierst Medizin und probierst nebenbei schon aus, was mit KI alles geht? Bei uns bringst du beides zusammen. Du testest Prompts für echten Datenanfragen, prüfst KI-Ergebnisse mit deinem medizinischen Wissen und baust kleine Prototypen mit. Und du erlebst, wie daraus Produkte werden. Unser Team Medical Science ist der medizinische Kern von BetterDoc. Wir übersetzen medizinisches Wissen in Produkte: strukturierte Daten, Entscheidungslogik und zunehmend KI. Ärztinnen und Ärzte bauen bei uns selbst Prototypen und bringen sie gemeinsam mit Product und Engineering live. Als Werkstudent arbeitest du direkt in diesem Team mit. Zur Verstärkung suchen wir ab sofort einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d) am Standort Köln oder remote. Deine Aufgaben Im Tagesgeschäft Medizinische Datenbank pflegen: Du hältst unsere medizinische Datenbank aktuell. Du recherchierst gezielt, bereitest Daten strukturiert auf und validierst sie systematisch. Analysen und Reportings: Du wirkst bei Auswertungen medizinischer Daten für interne Entscheidungen mit. Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du hilfst dabei, Arbeitsprozesse und Konzepte rund um unsere Datenbank weiterzuentwickeln und zu automatisieren. KI und Prototypen Prompts und Prototypen mitentwickeln: Du schreibst und testest Prompts und baust gemeinsam mit dem Team kleine Werkzeuge, zum Beispiel mit Claude, Python, SQL oder Google Apps Script. KI-Ergebnisse medizinisch prüfen: Du bewertest Ergebnisse unserer KI-Anwendungen fachlich, baust Test- und Referenzdatensätze mit auf und findest Fehler, bevor sie bei Patienten ankommen. Medizinisches Wissen strukturieren: Du überführst medizinische Informationen in strukturierte Daten und Klassifikationen wie ICD, OPS und SNOMED CT. Mit dem Produktteam zusammenarbeiten: Du bringst deine medizinische Perspektive in die Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Systeme mit Product und Engineering ein und siehst, wie ein Prototyp zum Produkt wird. Dein Profil Du studierst Humanmedizin und bist an einer deutschen Universität eingeschrieben, idealerweise im klinischen Studienabschnitt. title: Amazon Marketplace Manager (m/f/d)
description: HYROX is a global sports event series that combines running and functional fitness training in a unique race format. Founded in Germany in 2017, HYROX has evolved into a worldwide fitness movement with events across five continents, attracting millions of athletes every season. We are building the premier global fitness racing brand, empowering people of all backgrounds to train and compete together. To accelerate our rapid e-commerce expansion and scale our growing product portfolio (including HYROX Nutrition and Apparel), we are looking for an analytical and hands-on Amazon Marketplace Manager (m/f/d) to own, optimize, and grow our Amazon presence across key international markets. Apply now and join us on our journey to redefine fitness racing! YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Marketplace Strategy & Growth: Own the end-to-end management, P&L responsibility, and strategic expansion of our Amazon Seller/Vendor accounts across key international marketplaces (EU, UK, US). Listing Optimization & Brand Presence: Create, manage, and continuously optimize product detail pages (SEO-driven titles, bullet points, backend keywords), A+ Content, and our HYROX Brand Store to maximize conversion rates and brand consistency. Amazon Advertising (PPC & DSP) : Plan, execute, and optimize data-driven Amazon Ads campaigns (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display) to maximize ROI, lower ACOS/TACOS, and drive profitable revenue growth. Inventory, Pricing & Operations: Monitor stock levels, forecast demand in close collaboration with Supply Chain and Operations, manage FBA/FBM logistics, and ensure pricing consistency across our D2C and marketplace channels. Analytics, Reporting & Market Intelligence: Track key marketplace KPIs (sales, traffic, conversion rates, Buy Box share, reviews), conduct competitor and keyword analyses, and translate data insights into actionable growth initiatives. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with the Nutrition, Marketing, Creative, and Product teams to align marketplace launches, seasonal promotions (e.g., Prime Day, Black Friday), and global brand campaigns. YOUR PROFILE Experience : 6+ years of hands-on experience managing and scaling brands on Amazon (Seller Central and/or Vendor Central), ideally within Sports Nutrition, FMCG, Apparel, or the Fitness/Lifestyle sector. Tool & Data Savvy: Proficient in Excel/Google Sheets and standard Amazon analytics/SEO tools (e.g., Helium 10, Jungle Scout, DataDive, or Perpetua); familiarity with project management tools like Monday.com is a plus. Operational & Commercial Mindset: Solid understanding of supply chain workflows, FBA inventory management, pricing strategies, and marketplace compliance. title: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – Microsoft 365 & Infrastruktur
description: Gestalten Sie die IT von morgen – mit technischem Know-how, eigenen Ideen und einem vielseitigen Aufgabenbereich. Sie möchten nicht nur Systeme administrieren, sondern eine IT-Landschaft aktiv weiterentwickeln? Sie schätzen die Vielfalt einer internen IT-Abteilung und fühlen sich in einer Windows- und Microsoft-365-Umgebung zu Hause? Dann bietet Ihnen die DOMUS AG eine spannende berufliche Perspektive. Die DOMUS Steuerberatungs-AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft ist ein etabliertes Beratungsunternehmen mit rund 130 Mitarbeitenden und besonderer Expertise in der Immobilien- und Wohnungswirtschaft. Als Teil einer deutschlandweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe verbindet sie fachliche Kompetenz mit einem professionellen und zukunftsorientierten Arbeitsumfeld. Zur Erweiterung des bestehenden IT-Teams am Standort Berlin sucht die DOMUS AG einen engagierten IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d), der Freude an vielseitigen Infrastrukturaufgaben hat und die Transformation der bestehenden IT-Systeme aktiv mitgestaltet. Hier können Sie etwas bewegen Sie administrieren und entwickeln die bestehende Microsoft-Windows-Infrastruktur einschließlich Windows-Domänen, Datei- und Druckdiensten weiter. Sie unterstützen die Mitarbeitenden bei technischen Fragestellungen – sowohl vor Ort als auch remote. Sie betreuen Telefonanlagen, SIP-Trunks sowie Druck- und Multifunktionssysteme. Sie übernehmen Aufgaben in der IT-Dokumentation, IT-Beschaffung und Inventarverwaltung und koordinieren externe IT-Dienstleister. Abwechslungsreiche IT-Aufgaben: Ein breites technologisches Umfeld statt der Beschränkung auf einzelne Systeme. Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten: Aktive Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung und Modernisierung der IT-Infrastruktur. Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten nach individueller Absprache. Individuelle Weiterbildung: Unterstützung bei Ihrer persönlichen und fachlichen Entwicklung. Gesundheit und Mobilität: Gesundheitsangebote und JobRad. Warum sich Ihr Wechsel zur DOMUS AG lohnt Bei der DOMUS AG verbinden Sie die Vorteile eines etablierten Beratungsunternehmens mit den vielseitigen Herausforderungen einer sich weiterentwickelnden IT-Landschaft. Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für Systeme, die für den Arbeitsalltag des gesamten Unternehmens von zentraler Bedeutung sind. Gleichzeitig erhalten Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihre Erfahrungen einzubringen, neue Technologien kennenzulernen und gemeinsam mit dem bestehenden IT-Team die zukünftige Infrastruktur mitzugestalten. Ob Sie bereits in einer internen IT-Abteilung tätig sind oder aus einem IT-Systemhaus in eine unternehmensinterne Position wechseln möchten – hier können Sie Ihre technischen Stärken vielseitig einsetzen und weiterentwickeln. title: Werkstudent - Master Data Management (MDM) (m/w/d)
description: Wir sind die Berater der Weltmarktführer: Hochmotivierte Expertinnen und Experten, die als erfolgreiches Team digitale End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesslösungen vorantreiben. Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben. Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet Dir die Türen für anspruchsvolle Projekte mit einzigartigen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Werde Teil einer der besten und verlässlichsten Beratungen und nutze vielfältige Entwicklungschancen. Als engagiertes Teammitglied kannst Du bei uns schnell Verantwortung übernehmen und über Dich hinauswachsen. Du triffst auf ein starkes Team, das zusammenhält und wirklich etwas bewegen will. In unserer Business Unit Master Data Management (MDM)  beschäftigen wir uns mit einer zentralen Grundlage erfolgreicher Unternehmen: verlässlichen, gut organisierten und intelligent genutzten Daten. Zur Unterstützung unseres Managements suchen wir eine engagierte studentische Verstärkung am Standort Heidelberg . Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Management unserer Business Unit zusammen  und erhältst Einblicke in die unterschiedlichen Themen, die zur Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung einer Business Unit gehören. Von Management-Präsentationen und organisatorischen Aufgaben über Business Development und Presales bis hin zu People Development, Marketing und Kommunikation: Dich erwartet eine abwechslungsreiche Rolle, in der du Verantwortung übernehmen, eigene Ideen einbringen und gleichzeitig die Welt von Master Data Management, SAP und Consulting kennenlernen kannst. Was Dich erwartet Management Support:  Du unterstützt unser Management bei der Vorbereitung von Präsentationen, Workshops, Entscheidungsgrundlagen und internen Management-Terminen. Planung & Koordination:  Du organisierst und koordinierst unterschiedliche Aktivitäten, Termine und Themen und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Aufgaben den Überblick. Business Development & Presales:  Du begleitest Vertriebs- und Angebotsprozesse und unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Kundenpräsentationen, Recherchen und Presales-Unterlagen. Marketing & Communication:  Du wirkst bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Marketing- und Kommunikationsaktivitäten mit, beispielsweise bei unserem Webauftritt, Präsentationsmaterialien oder Formaten wie Master Data Monday  auf LinkedIn. People & Organization:  Du unterstützt bei Themen rund um Onboarding, unser Traineeprogramm und weitere People-Development-Aktivitäten. AI im Arbeitsalltag:  Du setzt moderne AI-Tools gezielt ein, um Informationen zu recherchieren und zu strukturieren, Inhalte aufzubereiten sowie Präsentationen und weitere Management-Unterlagen effizient zu erstellen. Eigene Verantwortung:  Mit zunehmender Erfahrung übernimmst du eigene Arbeitspakete und kleinere Initiativen und bringst deine Ideen aktiv ein. Was wir uns wünschen Du studierst Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Kommunikationswissenschaften oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang. PowerPoint gehört zu deinen Stärken:  Du hast Spaß daran, komplexe Informationen zu strukturieren und daraus klare und professionelle Präsentationen zu entwickeln. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Microsoft Office , insbesondere PowerPoint, Excel und Word. Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit generativer AI  und nutzt Tools wie Microsoft Copilot oder ChatGPT bereits produktiv für Recherche, Strukturierung und Content-Erstellung. Du arbeitest strukturiert, organisiert und selbstständig  und behältst auch bei unterschiedlichen Themen und Ansprechpartnern den Überblick. Du bist kommunikativ , trittst sicher auf und arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Menschen und Fachbereichen zusammen. Zuverlässigkeit und Diskretion  sind für dich selbstverständlich. Aufgrund der engen Zusammenarbeit mit dem Management gehst du verantwortungsvoll mit vertraulichen Informationen um. Du interessierst dich für Consulting, Business Management, Digitalisierung und Daten. Erste Berührungspunkte mit SAP oder Master Data Management  sind ein Plus, aber ausdrücklich kein Muss . Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: HAIN GmbH – Tradition trifft Innovation. Deine Zukunft beginnt bei uns! Über 67 Jahre Erfahrung. Drei Generationen Leidenschaft. Ein Familienunternehmen mit Zukunft. Die HAIN GmbH ist ein inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen in dritter Generation und zählt zu den etablierten Vertriebs- und Serviceunternehmen für professionelle Printinglösungen, ergonomische Büroeinrichtungen und moderne Arbeitsplatzkonzepte. Mit unserem Hauptsitz in Offenbach am Main und unserem Standort in Aschaffenburg verbinden wir langjährige Erfahrung mit innovativen Technologien, individuellen Kundenlösungen und einem hohen Dienstleistungsanspruch. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel! Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Offenbach am Main suchen wir für unsere Printingabteilung ab sofort eine engagierte kaufmännische Persönlichkeit in Vollzeit, die Organisationstalent, Zahlenverständnis und Kommunikationsstärke miteinander verbindet. Vertragsabwicklung: Prüfung von Vertragsunterlagen, Konditionen und abrechnungsrelevanten Daten auf Vollständigkeit und Richtigkeit. Kundenbetreuung: Kompetenter Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden bei kaufmännischen, vertraglichen und abrechnungsbezogenen Fragestellungen. Auftragsbearbeitung: Erfassung, Bearbeitung und Überwachung von Kundenaufträgen sowie Erstellung relevanter kaufmännischer Dokumente. Vertragsüberwachung: Kontrolle von Vertragslaufzeiten, Fristen, Verlängerungen, Kündigungen und Vertragsänderungen. Rechnungsprüfung: Prüfung vertragsbezogener Eingangsrechnungen und Klärung von Abweichungen. Datenpflege: Zuverlässige Pflege und Verwaltung von Kunden-, Vertrags- und Abrechnungsdaten in unserem ERP-System. Abteilungsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit Vertrieb, Service, Buchhaltung und externen Geschäftspartnern. Prozessoptimierung: Aktive Mitgestaltung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer kaufmännischen Abläufe. Deine Arbeit bildet die Grundlage für zuverlässige Abrechnungen, zufriedene Kunden und wirtschaftlich erfolgreiche Geschäftsprozesse. Dein Profil – Kaufmännische Kompetenz trifft Organisationstalent Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die mitdenkt, Verantwortung übernimmt und Freude daran hat, kaufmännische Geschäftsvorgänge eigenständig zu bearbeiten. Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Berufsausbildung, beispielsweise als Kaufmann für Büromanagement, Industriekaufmann, Bankkaufmann oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation (jeweils m/w/d). Idealerweise Berufserfahrung in der Auftragsbearbeitung, Vertragsverwaltung, Leasingabwicklung, Fakturierung oder kaufmännischen Sachbearbeitung. Gutes Zahlenverständnis und ausgeprägtes kaufmännisches Denkvermögen. Kenntnisse im Bereich Leasing-, Miet-, Finanzierungs- oder Serviceverträge sind von Vorteil. Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Office, insbesondere Excel und Word. Erfahrungen mit ERP- oder Warenwirtschaftssystemen sind wünschenswert. Selbstständige, strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise. Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Kunden und Geschäftspartnern. Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Zuverlässigkeit und ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch an die eigene Arbeit. Teamfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative und lösungsorientiertes Denken. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Du kommst aus dem Bankenwesen, der Leasingbranche oder dem kaufmännischen Innendienst? Auch ohne Erfahrung in der Printingbranche bist du bei uns herzlich willkommen. Entscheidend sind dein kaufmännisches Verständnis, deine Persönlichkeit und deine Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Das bieten wir dir – Wertschätzung, Verantwortung und Perspektiven Bei HAIN erwartet dich mehr als ein klassischer Bürojob. Wir bieten dir einen verantwortungsvollen Aufgabenbereich, moderne Arbeitsbedingungen und langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Langfristige Perspektive: Eine Vollzeitposition in einem etablierten, inhabergeführten Familienunternehmen. Attraktive Vergütung: Marktgerechte Bezahlung entsprechend deiner Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung. Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten: Ein vielseitiger Aufgabenbereich mit Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten und Raum für eigene Ideen. Moderner Arbeitsplatz: Hochwertige Büroausstattung und ein ergonomisch gestalteter Arbeitsplatz. Gesundheit: Jährliches Gesundheitsbudget und Zuschüsse für sportliche Aktivitäten, beispielsweise für dein Fitnessstudio. Finanzielle Vorsorge: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und vermögenswirksame Leistungen. Zusätzliche Benefits: Mitarbeitergratifikationen. Weiterbildung: Regelmäßige interne und externe Schulungen sowie fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Unternehmenskultur: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine unkomplizierte Duz-Kultur. Teamgeist: Ein kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit gegenseitiger Unterstützung und gemeinsamen Wachstumszielen. Wir schätzen Menschen, die mitdenken, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns etwas bewegen möchten. Deine ersten Monate bei HAIN – Gemeinsam erfolgreich starten Mit einer strukturierten und praxisnahen Einarbeitung schaffen wir die Grundlage für deinen erfolgreichen Einstieg. Du lernst unser Team, unsere kaufmännischen Prozesse, Vertragsmodelle und eingesetzten ERP-Systeme kennen. Erfahrene Kollegen begleiten dich bei deinen ersten Auftrags- und Vertragsvorgängen und stehen dir bei fachlichen Fragen zur Seite. Interne und externe Schulungen unterstützen dich dabei, dein Wissen rund um unsere Vertragsstrukturen, Abrechnungsprozesse und die Zusammenarbeit mit Banken und Leasinggesellschaften gezielt auszubauen. Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du eigenverantwortlich deine Aufgaben und entwickelst dich zu einem kompetenten Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden, Finanzierungspartner und internen Abteilungen. Auch nach deiner Einarbeitung unterstützen wir dich bei deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung. Deine Kompetenz. Deine Verantwortung. Deine Zukunft bei HAIN. Du möchtest nicht einfach nur Aufträge erfassen, sondern kaufmännische Prozesse eigenverantwortlich betreuen, mit Kunden und Finanzierungspartnern kommunizieren und deine Fähigkeiten in einem anspruchsvollen Aufgabenbereich einsetzen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Bewirb dich jetzt unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p>As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you’d be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers.&nbsp; Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.</p> <p><strong>This role can be office-based (London) or fully remote in the UK. This role requires travel up to 50% of the time.</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world: </strong>Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: </strong>One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>You build genuine relationships with your customers:</strong> The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best:</strong> Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>You are a team player:</strong> At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.</li> <li>Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.</li> <li>Deliver the work products that get deals done. Think discoveries, demonstrations, value assessments, proof of concept implementations, etc.</li> <li>Write scripts against our open API that solve real-world problems for companies that deliver essential services (for example), and document them for your fellow SEs to use.</li> <li>Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.</li> <li>Act as a liaison between Samsara’s product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.</li> <li>Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.</li> <li>Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.</li> <li>Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.</li> <li>Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.</li> <li>4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.</li> <li>Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.</li> <li>Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts.</li> <li>Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.</li> <li>Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.</li> <li>Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.</li> <li>Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.</li> <li>Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language.</li> <li>Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs.</li> <li>Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.</li> <li>Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.).</li> <li>Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.</li> <li>Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p> <p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email <a ---------- or <a href="https://forms.gle/DrM6DFQUiSgfPtCVA">click here</a> if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Authenticity</strong></p> <p>We use <a href="https://hiretofu.com/privacyPolicy">Tofu</a>, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s <a href="https://www.samsara.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more information.</p> <p><strong>Fraudulent Employment Offers</strong></p> <p>Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>As a Sales Engineer for our Enterprise Select business, you’ll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting sales in winning new business and expanding existing business, and (2) contributing to the SE Team on the quest of continually raising the bar. There is an expectation that an SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win business. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc.</p> <p>Additionally, an SE is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a remote role, requiring travel up to 75%.</p> <p><strong>You should apply if:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world: </strong>Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</li> <li><strong>You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: </strong>One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>You build genuine relationships with your customers:</strong> The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.</li> <li><strong>You want to be with the best:</strong> Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>You are a team player:</strong> At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Demonstrate the value proposition of Samsara’s products and services along with the platform's core capabilities on-site, remotely via webinar sessions, or at field events such as conferences and trade shows.</li> <li>Facilitate live proof-of-concept trials for prospective customers including hardware installation in and around vehicles and/or equipment ensuring prospects understand - and are fully utilizing - the Samsara platform.</li> <li>Work closely with Product Management, and other relevant teams, to help develop the Samsara platform.</li> <li>Respond to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.</li> <li>Be organized and analytical, and eliminate sales obstacles using creative and adaptive approaches.</li> <li>Demonstrate comfort working for a dynamic technical organization with a fast-growing partner and customer base.</li> <li>Remain highly available to Sales and cross-functional teams, making a measurable impact on Sales and product development in your region, and contributing to SE Team enablement.</li> <li>Be a dynamic contributor on both Sales and SE Team internal communications channels.</li> <li>Partner with account executives to plan, prepare, and execute strategic deals in complex sales cycles.</li> <li>Discover customer processes, needs and pain, translate that understanding to become a welcomed trusted advisor.</li> <li>Successfully match customer pain points and requirements to proposed solutions.</li> <li>Contribute to the team via technical and industry knowledge, training, etc.</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles and 3+ years of pre-sales experience</li> <li>Experience with Enterprise sales cycles or equivalent</li> <li>Consistent track record selling complex solutions</li> <li>Clinical execution of discovery, through to POV, and technical win.&nbsp;</li> <li>Understand and appreciate value selling, and MEDDICC.</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Previous hands-on experience with customer evaluations and deployments</li> <li>Well-versed in one of the following: cloud software, IOT, networking, automation, and control systems</li> <li>Experience with integration projects. At minimum comprehend RESTFul APIs. A plus for scripting (Python, javascript, etc.) experience</li> <li>IoT, hardware gadgets, vehicles, or general tinkering experience (work or hobby) a plus</li> <li>Experience working with Fleet, Logistics, Supply Chain, Telematics, Manufacturing, or general operations background a plus</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.</span></p> <p><strong>Belonging at Samsara</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.</p> <p><strong>Accommodations&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email <a ---------- or <a href="https://forms.gle/DrM6DFQUiSgfPtCVA">click here</a> if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Authenticity</strong></p> <p>We use <a href="https://hiretofu.com/privacyPolicy">Tofu</a>, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s <a href="https://www.samsara.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more information.</p> <p><strong>Fraudulent Employment Offers</strong></p> <p>Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Our aim is to create the most productive, AI-enabled distributed clinical workforce working at the intersection of public and private health.By joining Heim, you will play a pivotal role in building the infrastructure that puts clinical care in the home.

WHAT IT'S LIKE TO WORK AT HEIM

We are reinventing how healthcare is delivered. Here are the things that shape your day-to-day:

  • Meaningful problems – we build systems that improve how organisations understand and care for people. The work is complex, applied, and grounded in real-world patient impact

  • High standards, low ego – you’ll work alongside thoughtful engineers, clinicians, and operators who care about clarity and good judgement

  • Speed with intent – we move quickly but deliberately. Clear ownership, evidence-based decisions, outcomes over output

  • Simple, elegant solutions – we have a strong bias towards code that is easy to reason about, hard to break, and built to outlast the sprint it was born in

  • Direct access to founders – you’ll have visibility into and input on the direction of the company

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

This is a full-stack TypeScript role in the truest sense – you will own problems across the entire system, from UI to infrastructure. AI isn’t a feature here; it’s a first principle. We expect you to use agentic coding tools fluently (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) and to be building your own views on where agentic workflows can meaningfully improve what we ship.

You’ll be working on systems where the stakes are real: scheduling errors affect patient care, data quality issues affect clinical decisions, and downtime has consequences. That context sharpens every technical choice you make.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Design and build product features end-to-end across the Heim tech stack – owning them from first principles to production

  • Architect and implement AI-powered workflows: scheduling optimisation, practitioner dispatch, clinical data enrichment, and agentic referral automations that reduce manual touchpoints for nurses

  • Own the full lifecycle of features – from TypeScript frontend through to backend services, infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and testing – without relying on separate DevOps or QA teams to close the loop

  • Build and maintain the APIs, services, and data models that underpin clinical operations – with the reliability and auditability a regulated environment demands

  • Collaborate with our product and clinical ops teams to translate ambiguous real-world problems into working software

  • Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed and quality, and advocate clearly when the trade-off isn’t acceptable

  • Contribute to the architecture and infrastructure decisions that will shape the platform as we scale to NHS Trusts across the UK and into new markets

  • Leave the codebase better than you found it – improving performance, clarity, and resilience as part of everyday delivery

HOW WE WORK

  • Small team, fast loops, few layers – your decisions land fast and the feedback is real

  • We operate a hybrid team set up, and value high quality in person time so you must be able to commute to our central London office

  • Technical judgement is respected and expected – you’ll have a real voice in architectural decisions

  • Disagreement is normal. Good ideas win, not hierarchical ones

  • Strong bias toward execution: fewer meetings, clear ownership, and decisions grounded in evidence


WHO THIS IS FOR

You’re a senior full-stack engineer who acts like a founder. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. You’re comfortable roaming an unfamiliar part of the codebase when something needs fixing, and you’ll ask sharp clarifying questions before committing to an approach.

  • Proven ability to own the full delivery lifecycle: frontend, backend, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, deployment, and testing – without handing off to separate DevOps or QA teams

Infrastructure and cloud experience (GCP or equivalent) beyond the basics

Want to help defence and national security organisations see the risk hidden in their supply chains, their suppliers, their people and the threats they track? We're looking for an EMEA lead for our National Security and Defence solutions. You'll build this sub-industry for Quantexa with the UK and allied defence and national security markets worldwide, set its direction and take it to market with our partners. Defence ministries, armed forces, intelligence agencies and homeland security bodies hold supplier, personnel and intelligence data in separate, often classified systems. Hidden foreign ownership behind a supplier, a dual-use export, procurement fraud, a gap in a vetting record, a sanctions or proliferation network, or a sign of hostile state activity is easy to miss. That's the problem we solve. We connect that data into resolved entities and networks – who owns, supplies, funds and works for whom – so analysts can see the connections that matter, across supply chain risk, personnel vetting, counter-proliferation and intelligence analysis. People make the decisions; we give them the full picture. We deliver in defence and national security with security-cleared partners and system integrators. You'd lead this from our Product team, which sits where the market meets the product. You'll report to our VP Government Solutions. Complex problems, senior audiences, real public impact. Ready? What you'll be doing. Own the National Security and Defence proposition across EMEA – the positioning, the messaging and the organisations we go after – and turn what you hear in the market into requirements that shape our EMEA roadmap. Make sure it works – keep one set of National Security and Defence decks, demos, blueprints and playbooks in line with the released product. Be our senior expert worldwide – support Sales and Field Engineering on the opportunities that matter, as a trusted advisor to senior government stakeholders. Build our voice in the market – thought leadership, industry events, analyst briefings and client roundtables. Team up with Marketing and Sales – on campaigns, competitor analysis, business cases and the enablement that helps our teams and partners sell with confidence. Work with defence primes and system integrators – the partners who deliver our defence and national security work – on joint propositions, pitches and enablement, within our policies on where and with whom we work in defence and national security. Bring the field back into Product – decide which field work becomes product, and work with R&D to keep the solution ahead. What success looks like. In your first 6 months: National Security and Defence proposition, messaging and priority organisations (defence, intelligence and homeland security) agreed for each region and in use by Sales and Field Engineering. One current set of National Security and Defence material that matches the released product. The partners we take the National Security and Defence proposition to market with agreed, and each one enabled. By 12 months: A measurable contribution to National Security and Defence pipeline and wins across EMEA. A recognised voice in the market, with [n] customer or partner proof points we can use. Field Engineering and our main partners able to sell and demo the National Security and Defence solutions without you. What you'll bring. You have deep expertise in defence or national security, ideally in supply chain risk, security vetting, counter-proliferation or intelligence analysis. Don't tick every box below? If you recognise yourself in most of it, we'd still like to hear from you. Real depth in defence or national security. You have built or run supply chain risk, security vetting, counter-proliferation or intelligence analysis systems or strategies, inside a defence ministry, the armed forces, an intelligence or homeland security agency, at a prime or system integrator, or advising one. Credible with analysts. Credible with senior officers and officials. A voice the market listens to. About IMU Biosciences

IMU Biosciences has developed proprietary platform technologies that generate and translate vast system-level immune data into actionable insights and tools to drive the development of precision medicines across a variety of diseases. IMU leverages advanced immune profiling with proprietary AI and machine learning analytics to uncover novel clinical immune signatures. IMU continues to establish partnerships with leading pharma and biotech companies to advance disease diagnosis, optimise product selection, and improve patient stratification and monitoring - while also building its own pipeline of innovative products.

About The Role

 

Core Responsibilities

Day to day responsibilities

  • Perform isolation and cryopreservation of cells from human blood samples

  • Perform single-cell RNA sequencing assays, ensure accurate sample identification, labelling, tracking and traceability throughout the sample processing workflow

  • Assess sample quality and suitability for downstream applications, escalating samples that do not meet predefined acceptance criteria

  • Ensure samples are processed, stored, and handled within specified timeframes and conditions to maintain sample integrity

  • Maintain accurate sample inventories and update relevant laboratory information management systems (LIMS) or sample tracking records

  • Monitor reagent and consumable stock levels, anticipate upcoming requirements, and communicate replenishment needs to the relevant team members

  • Ensure laboratory data and assay results are accurately recorded, reviewed, and stored in accordance with established procedures

  • Identify, document and escalate sample discrepancies, labelling errors, or deviations from established sample handling procedures

  • Perform investigation of unexpected assay results and contribute to identifying potential root causes and corrective actions

  • Maintain IMU lab quality control measures

  • Perform and assess routine equipment quality control checks

  • Monitor equipment performance and promptly escalate abnormal readings, equipment failures, or maintenance requirements

  • Involved with analysing, reporting and storing assay results

  • Establish priorities when involved in multiple projects and deliver on target

  • Maintain consistent and regular progress reporting to senior staff members and have effective lines of communication with all colleagues by being proactive with providing updates regarding progress and also voicing ideas, inputs and feedbacks

  • Communicate effectively across cross-functional teams

Supporting responsibilities

  • Perform assay optimisation and troubleshooting experiments

  • Participate in method verification, validation, or performance evaluation activities, as appropriate to the laboratory's quality framework

  • Provide technical and organisational support to the team and ensure that reagents are prepared, stored and used in an appropriate manner

  • Help with general laboratory maintenance including aliquoting, stock checking, receiving and storing of deliveries, day-to-day maintenance and cleaning of instruments and equipment

  • Coordinate sample shipment and receipt from our clients and partners

  • Contribute to highly collaborative research projects, working closely with colleagues

Continuous improvement and innovation of our practices

  • Identify and propose opportunities to improve laboratory workflows, sample processing efficiency, assay reproducibility, and resource utilisation

  • Support the development and implementation of laboratory automation workflows to improve consistency, efficiency, and scalability

  • Support the evaluation and implementation of new laboratory methods, reagents, equipment, and technologies

The above list of responsibilities may not be exhaustive, and the post holder will be required to undertake such tasks and responsibilities as may reasonably be expected within the scope, purpose and grading of the post.

 

Team and Ways of Working

Lab team

  • Office based, 5 days a week

  • Integrate in the molecular biology team

  • Work closely with flow cytometry part sub team

 
 

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

Qualification Requirements

  • A minimum of BSc/MSc in biological science degree with relevant work experience

 

Technical Must-Haves (Essential Skills)

  • Experience in molecular biology techniques including nucleic acid isolation, PCR, and next generation sequencing

  • Proven hands-on experience with single-cell transcriptomics assays (RNAseq essential), using platforms such as 10x, Parse, Rhapsody, or similar.

  • Familiar with working with blood and tissue samples

Nice-to-Haves (Desirable Skills)

  • Experience designing experiments

  • Experience with automated systems

  • Experience using LIMS and ELN

  • Experience working with human biological samples and familiarity with Human Tissue Act (2004)

  • Knowledge of ISO 15189:2022 and ISO 13485

  • Background or interest in immunology, with a preference for candidates who have worked within drug discovery / development.

  • Experience working in biotech or pharma space

 

Key Competencies

  • Able to work flexible hours when necessary to accommodate sample delivery schedules and R&D experiments

  • Troubleshooting skills and ability to independently drive experiments to completion

  • Meticulous attention to detail and a strong focus on accuracy

  • Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks to meet deadlines under pressure

  • Proactive/autonomous

  • Good interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work independently and as part of a team

  • Excellent teamwork, communication, and self-motivation in a fast-paced biotech environment

  • Eager and open to learning new skills at the cutting edge of immunology

Why Join Us?

● Competitive salary and company bonus scheme

● Pension, health insurance, life assurance, and income protection

● Fast-paced, collaborative startup culture

● Strong opportunities for career development and progression

 
 
 

Compensation: £47K – £54K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • Up to 15% bonus payable per annum

You embed with a small number of accounts, work in their environment, and own whatever stands between them and production on Fireworks: the model, the serving path, the integration, the performance. You scope the work before signature and deliver what you scoped. Depth over breadth: few accounts, owned end to end. What we value most is first principles thinking: reasoning about unfamiliar problems from the ground up rather than from playbooks. You take open models and make them better on a customer's task: SFT, LoRA and other parameter-efficient methods, reinforcement learning (RLHF, RLVR), distillation. Product Signal: Feed what customers need back to product and engineering, with enough precision to be actionable. Minimum Qualifications: Spikes in two or all three areas. For the ML spike: formal training (PhD, PhD in progress, or a strong MSc) and experience post-training LLMs specifically. For the infrastructure spike: experience with GPU infrastructure, distributed serving, or inference engines. Founder or founding engineer experience. Design Engineer

London, 5x days per week in-office

Vega is looking for a Design Engineer to join our product design and engineering team. You will design and develop the interfaces and interactions for asset managers to work with Vega agents. The role suits someone who has worked as both a product designer and a (front-end) engineer.


About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

In this role, you will:

  • Design for people nobody has ever designed for. Operations teams at the world's largest asset managers run fragmented, inefficient processes on software built without care or context. Sit with them, watch them work, and turn what you see into flows that get the job done faster without weakening their controls.

  • Take features through VegaOS from sketch to production. You design the flow, build it, and merge it into main alongside our engineers. Your spike is UI/UX but you don’t need full-time developers to build and ship your vision when push comes to shove. When something looks or feels wrong anywhere in the product, you confidently open the PRs yourself.

  • Work in code from the first conversation with a PM so the team argues about something real, not a Figma frame.

  • Design and build for AI in the loop. Much of VegaOS is screens where an agent has done part of the work and a human has to check it. Make that fast, legible and reversible.

description: Location: Oxford or London (Hybrid) The Mission: Why We Exist Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics. Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores – giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time. A Day in the Life At Genomics, we tackle major scientific challenges in harnessing genomic data to improve human health. This role is part of the Life Sciences team, working on a range of challenges spanning the therapeutic development cycle, with a particular focus on developing patient stratification strategies, advancing disease understanding using ‘omic data, and identifying novel biomarkers. The Scientist is an early-career member of the team, who will thrive in a highly collaborative team environment. With the team’s support, you will develop and execute innovative and rigorous scientific approaches, and will effectively communicate findings to both internal and external stakeholders. For example, a Scientist may: Apply and optimise risk tools for patient stratification that combine genetic information, through polygenic risk scores, with conventional risk factors, to find the individuals most at risk of disease onset or progression and those most likely to benefit from therapies. Cluster genetic variants by their effects on disease-relevant traits to reveal distinct biological mechanisms, and use partitioned polygenic scores to define patient subgroups that share underlying causal biology. Discover and validate novel biomarkers from clinical or ‘omic data, and apply them to stratify patient populations in large biobanks or clinical trials. To be successful in this role, you will: bring a strong foundation in the application of statistical and computational techniques in biomedical science that you can apply in innovative ways, thrive on analysing vast and diverse sources of ‘omic data using leading statistical or AI/ML approaches to make meaningful insights into complex problems, and take pride in effectively sharing your findings with others. Who You Are Essential: Solid foundations in statistics (e.g., modelling, regression), genetics and molecular biology, and statistical programming (e.g., Python or R). Experience using at least one of the following statistical genetics approaches: GWAS, colocalization, fine-mapping, Mendelian randomization, polygenic risk scores. Preferred: Experience defining phenotypes from electronic health records. Knowledge of Bayesian inference, high dimensional statistics, causal inference. Experience with software engineering practices (version control [Git & GitHub], testing, documentation, agentic coding) Experience building and running reproducible pipelines, e.g., using WDL, Snakemake, or NextFlow. Experience using cloud computing and trusted research environments, e.g., DNAnexus or Verily Workbench. Experience with methods development within statistical genetics. Vibrant Social Culture: From regular Town Halls and team picnics to organised sports events, our social committee ensures frequent opportunities to connect and celebrate. raw.title: Senior Engineer - Platform & Tooling
raw.description:
Who is Atominvest

Atominvest is the operating system for modern private markets asset managers. Our modular, flexible SaaS technology underpins key investor- and portfolio-management workflows.

Our customers are sophisticated private equity, growth equity, and private credit firms managing billions in assets globally. We aim to deliver ongoing high-quality outcomes for them through a long-term partnership mindset.

At Atominvest, you’ll be working on something very exciting: the future of work, investments and sustainability/ ethical investing for the world’s best investors and delivering a positive impact through this. Based on the growth we are experiencing, we think we’re on to something big.

It won’t be easy. Joining a scale up business is an amazing and rewarding challenge, pushing well beyond the boundaries of natural growth cycles. You’ll move quicker than feels comfortable and be brilliant at continually re-prioritizing what must get done to keep Atominvest growing year over year at the pace of the best SaaS companies on the planet.

We’ve gone from zero to ten, now we’re looking to go from ten to one hundred!

About the role

Hi, I'm Thomas, VP Engineering at Atominvest. This is the hire I'm most excited about, so I wanted to tell you about it myself.

You'll own the platform our clients run on and build the AI development harness our engineers work in day to day. That work runs from infrastructure to application code, so we're looking for an experienced engineer with breadth across both, and depth in at least one. Together, it's what lets a small, lean team, working alongside AI agents, ship like a much bigger one.

 

By platform, we mean everything our product and our engineers stand on: infrastructure, security, test automation, developer experience, and the agent pipelines that run through all of them. It's a broad, hands-on role. You'll write infrastructure as code for a new service one day and address network vulnerabilities the next, then enhance our AI development harness and release a new feature, all within the same month.

 

You might be a platform engineer who loves shipping product, or a full-stack engineer who has run serious production infrastructure. Either works.

As deployments grow more complex, the team needs your depth in infrastructure and distributed systems. You'll strengthen the architecture and make the design decisions the platform will rest on for years. Those decisions should leave room to grow, because future products may bring much larger volumes of data than we handle today.

It has to stay dependable while we do it. Our software needs to be available around the clock, every day of the year, and data integrity is critical. Our clients use Atominvest to report to their own investors, so a wrong number matters as much as an outage. Security, reliability and audit-readiness matter too. If you enjoy getting those right without slowing everything else down, you'll find plenty of fun things to work on.

The machine that builds the product

We're becoming AI-native. Agents do more and more of the mechanical work of writing code, and engineers build the machine that builds the product: the architecture, the specs, the limits agents work within, and the evals that tell us whether their output is right.

I think that moves an engineer's leverage upstream. When code is cheap, the scarce things are judgement and understanding. Which problem is worth solving? What does good look like for the person using it? Is the output actually right? Did what we shipped help? The best engineers I've worked with always solved the end problem, with code as the medium. Now that's most of the job.

That's why product and user understanding sit at the centre of how we work. An engineer who knows our clients' workflows can point agents at the right problem and spot when the result is subtly wrong. Without that, agents just build the wrong thing faster.

Your part is the AI development harness that makes this safe. That means sandboxed environments with synthetic data, scoped and audited access to logs and alerts, and evals and validation gates in CI. It also means firm lines, enforced by tooling, that keep production deploys and secrets in human hands, and client data out of reach of development agents.

You'll also build the agent orchestration pipelines that run in three places: in how we build software, in AI workflows inside the product our clients use, and in the internal tools our implementation team uses to onboard and configure clients.

What you'll do

Build the machine that builds the product

Most of your time goes here.

  • Build our AI development harness. Self-service infrastructure, a reproducible development environment, and the sandboxes, guardrails and evals that let agents take on more of the work safely, with results we can measure.

  • Automate quality. Build the QA automation pipeline: automated tests, validation gates and release checks that give us confidence in every change, including the ones agents write.

  • Orchestrate agents across the business. Build pipelines that run agents reliably and safely in our product workflows and our internal implementation tools, not just in engineering.

Own the platform

  • Own our infrastructure. We're migrating to ECS. You'll strengthen our ECS architecture, see the move through in safe, reversible stages, bring every resource under infrastructure as code, and retire the old deployment model.

  • Build security into the platform. Tenant-scoped credentials, per-tenant secrets, least-privilege access, and the audit trail that SOC 2 and our clients' security teams expect.

  • Make production observable. Set up the monitoring, alerting and tracing we rely on, and build playbooks for on-call and incident response which is shared amongst the team.

Work across the stack

  • Make the application changes the harness needs, such as synthetic data, test hooks and the specs agents work from.

  • Ship product. Pick up application work in TypeScript and React alongside the team. Over time, you'll learn the codebase as well as the platform it runs on.

  • Grow the team around you. Write the design notes and runbooks, pair with and review the work of other engineers, and mentor those who want to grow into infrastructure, so the platform never depends on one person.

Your first six months

  • Get the first parts of "the machine" running, and show that they make the team faster without lowering quality.

  • At the moment all of our end to end testing is done manually by our Product team. That's a massive manual overhead that bottlenecks our product development. You'll help build our AI-powered QA automation pipeline, so every change, whether a person or an agent wrote it, is tested automatically before it reaches clients.

  • Strengthen the ECS architecture and complete the move with no disruption to clients.

  • Get the platform fully into code, with tenant isolation and least privilege designed in.

  • Put in place the monitoring and on-call foundations the team will build on.

How you'll work

You'll own this area rather than work through a ticket queue. You'll decide what to build and when it's good enough, write your decisions down so others can challenge them, and tell us when something isn't worth doing. You'll work closely with Product from the start of significant work, because the platform exists to serve clients and the engineers building for them.

You and I will work together every day. We'll shape the technical direction together and think through the hard calls, and you'll have a direct line to every decision that affects your work. I'll back your judgement, and I'll expect you to push back when you think I'm wrong.

This is an individual contributor role, but we expect you to multiply the team: leading different areas at different times, and delivering through others as well as through your own work.

You'll probably enjoy this if

  • You'd rather build a platform properly than keep patching one.

  • You're product-minded. You've probably worked at a startup or scale-up, or even founded something yourself. Seeing your work out in the world, solving real problems, is what motivates you. You ask who a change is for before you ask how to build it.

  • You already work this way. Agents write much of your code, and your time goes on design, specs and judging the output. You've built AI tooling for yourself, and probably for others on your team.

  • You get satisfaction from making other engineers faster.

  • You're comfortable writing Terraform, an API endpoint and an answer to a client's security questionnaire in the same week.

  • You've been the person others come to with hard problems, and you've changed your mind publicly when the evidence said so.

This probably isn't for you if

  • You want a pure DevOps or SRE role.

  • You want to manage people right now. These opportunities might exist in the future, but for now we're small, lean and as flat as possible.

What you'll bring

Very few people match every line. If most of this describes you, we'd like to hear from you.

  • Deep, hands-on AWS. Several years running production workloads on ECS or EKS, with a solid grasp of IAM, networking and Lambda.

  • Infrastructure as code as a habit, with Terraform or CloudFormation, including bringing existing hand-built resources under code.

  • Scaling distributed systems. You've taken systems through real growth in load and data, and can teach others what you learnt.

  • Single-tenant SaaS experience. You know the isolation trade-offs and how to keep one client's data and credentials away from another's.

  • Security and compliance as part of engineering: least privilege, secrets management, and evidence for SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

  • Production experience: on-call, incidents, post-mortems, and observability tooling such as Datadog, Grafana or Honeycomb.

  • Full-stack product building. Senior TypeScript and Node.js, plus React, with a track record of shipping features end to end yourself, not just supporting the people who do.

  • Test automation and CI/CD. You've designed pipelines that test at the right levels and release safely, and you keep them fast and simple.

  • Tooling you've built for AI agents, not just used: agent configuration and orchestration, MCP servers or similar integrations, evals, automated review.

Our stack

TypeScript, Node.js, React and MongoDB Atlas, running on AWS. CircleCI and Bitbucket. AI coding agents are part of everyday work. You don't need experience of all of these.

How we hire

We want to see how you actually work, so there are no whiteboard puzzles.

  1. Screening call with me (20 minutes)

  2. Competencies interview with me (30 minutes)

  3. Technical deep dive with a few of our engineers (90 minutes)

  4. Culture fit interview with our CEO, Hemal (30 minutes)

I'll be your main point of contact throughout. You'll know what to expect before each stage, and if we don't make an offer, I'll give you feedback.
