title: Staff Data Engineer (AI Data Platform)
description: UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable. Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia. UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems. About the role The Staff Data Engineer (AI Data Platform) will design, build and operate the data platform that makes UFORCE’s operational data usable for AI model training and validation. You will connect diverse data sources—from high-frequency telemetry and time series to imagery, video, documents and structured records—and make the resulting data discoverable, governed and reproducible. You will work hands-on across architecture, pipelines, data quality and platform operations, while helping other engineers and partner teams make sound technical decisions. This is a staff-level individual contributor role for someone who combines strong engineering judgment with a practical approach to delivery. You will partner with ML, product, engineering, field and security teams to build a platform that works for real use cases and operating constraints. Model research and model performance decisions remain with the accountable ML and product owners. What you’ll do Design and deliver a data platform for ingesting, storing, discovering and preparing heterogeneous data for approved analytics and ML workflows. Build reliable batch and streaming pipelines for priority data sources, with validation, schema evolution, retries, backfills, replay and appropriate handling of failed data. Preserve the context needed to understand and trace data, including timestamps, source identity, format versions and provenance where available. Establish data contracts, metadata, interfaces and ownership boundaries that make data easier to find, understand and use across teams. Enable reproducible training and evaluation datasets, including source and transformation versions, labels, filters and split definitions. Build data-quality checks for issues such as missing data, corruption, duplication and temporal misalignment. Work with ML partners to surface coverage, sampling and leakage risks. Make data rights, classification, retention, permitted use and access restrictions visible and actionable. Design for the environments the work requires, which may include cloud, on-premises, sovereign or disconnected deployments. Instrument and operate data workflows with clear visibility into health, freshness, quality, throughput and cost. Document failure handling, recovery and operational ownership. Apply appropriate access controls, encryption, auditability and data-handling practices in partnership with security and other stakeholders. Lead technical decisions across teams, communicate trade-offs and risks, mentor engineers, and deliver reusable components in small, reviewable increments. What success looks like A coherent platform architecture and incremental roadmap support priority AI and product use cases, with clear interfaces and ownership. Priority data sources are ingested reliably and traceably, with agreed measures for completeness, freshness, quality and recovery. Approved datasets are discoverable, governed and reproducible from source data through transformations to training and evaluation outputs. ML teams can assess data quality, provenance and known limitations before using a dataset, and issues can be traced back and corrected. Platform workflows have actionable monitoring, documented recovery procedures and clear operational ownership. Security, deployment and cost constraints are understood and incorporated into platform decisions. Partner teams can use the platform effectively, and engineers are unblocked through clear designs, reusable tools and mentoring. Success measures and numerical targets will be established with the hiring manager and partner teams once baselines and operating constraints are understood. Required qualifications 8+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering or a related field. Data platform experience — designed, built and operated production data platforms or data-intensive systems end to end. Staff-level technical leadership — led architectural decisions and cross-team delivery, mentored engineers and communicated clearly with stakeholders. Hands-on engineering — strong Python and SQL skills, or equivalent, with experience in testing, code review and production-quality software. Data pipelines — built reliable batch and streaming pipelines, including validation, schema evolution, retries, backfills and replay. Data modalities — worked with structured or semi-structured data and at least one relevant modality, such as telemetry, time series, imagery, video or documents; understands provenance and temporal alignment. ML data foundations — experience with storage, cataloguing, lineage, quality controls and reproducible datasets, including versioning, splits and leakage or sampling risks. Platform operations — experience with observability, incident response, recovery, reliability and cost management. Security and governance — practical knowledge of access controls, encryption, auditability, retention and sensitive-data handling. Nice to have Experience working with robotics, connected-device fleets or other operational systems that produce high-frequency or multimodal data. Experience designing data systems for constrained connectivity, offline, air-gapped or sovereign environments. Experience supporting defence, regulated or other security-sensitive customers. The nature of combat has changed. Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability. And UFORCE is ready. Are You? title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. The Role We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organisation. You'll run the complex analysis and modelling behind target setting and annual planning for the entire commercial organisation. You will also help the Director set and execute the revenue analytics strategy, and run the insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business. As you ramp up, you will take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations. We are looking for someone with very strong analytical and modelling skills, which are the foundation of the role, especially in your first two quarters. Just as important, we want someone who is commercially minded and keen to grow into a generalist role, broadening from there into revenue insights and forecasting. What You’ll Do First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards. First 180 days: Lead the analysis for the annual planning and target-setting cycle, and automate the core of revenue reporting and insights with AI tooling. First 12 months: Take on co-ownership of the forecasting cadence with the Director of Revenue Operations. What Will You Be Doing? Run Complex Modelling & Analysis Run complex analysis and modelling to support target setting and the annual planning process for the entire commercial organisation, made up of around 600 commercial roles across SDRs, AEs and Account Managers. Build and maintain the models behind target setting: capacity, quota and productivity assumptions, and territory and segment allocation. Frame the key planning questions, choose the method, pressure-test scenarios and sensitivities, and deliver clear recommendations to revenue leadership, explaining the trade-offs in plain language. Work as the senior analytical partner to the other analyst on the team: stay hands-on in the models while setting the quality bar and documentation standards, so each planning cycle is repeatable and auditable. Build the Revenue Analytics Strategy Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order. Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan. Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider commercial organisation rely on. Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it. Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep. Grow Into Forecasting Co-run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders and the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking. Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion. Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement. What You’ll Bring Strong experience in Revenue or Sales Operations, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level. Advanced modelling and scenario analysis skills (spreadsheets and SQL), ideally with experience in target setting, capacity planning or annual planning for a large commercial organisation. Solid Salesforce reporting skills and working fluency in a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), with a practical, business-first approach to data. Commercial judgement and exposure to quota-carrying teams such as Account Executives, plus a generalist mindset: as comfortable building a dashboard as a planning model or running a forecasting call. The ability to influence sales leadership and revenue executives, and to own ambiguous problems end to end, from framing the question to landing the recommendation. You will also help the Director set and execute the revenue analytics strategy, and run the insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business. As you ramp up, you will take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

We are looking for someone with very strong analytical and modelling skills, which are the foundation of the role, especially in your first two quarters. Just as important, we want someone who is commercially minded and keen to grow into a generalist role, broadening from there into revenue insights and forecasting.


What You’ll Do

  • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

description: Project Tricorder — Clinical Infrastructure for Field Operations We're looking for a hands-on engineer to build two foundations of the Tricorder product: the evaluation harness and training data pipeline behind our AI models, and a clinical knowledge base grounded in tactical combat care, SNOMED CT and ICD-10. About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/ Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward. Tricorder builds the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It is a dual-use venture serving defence medical and civilian pre-hospital care. Our prototype product is already in user testing. Edge AI sits at the core: multimodal language models that turn video, sensor data and clinical notes into patient records, drive predictions and inform data-driven learnings across deployments. To trust those models in the field, we need rigorous data and evaluation - that's where you come in. What you'll do You'll own two workstreams, working day to day with the founder and the FF build team. 1. Data pipeline and evaluation harness Build the data foundations that tell us whether our models are good enough for clinical use. Data labelling: design labelling schemas and guidelines, set up tooling, and run labelling with clinical input, including quality checks and inter-annotator agreement. Data processing: build reproducible pipelines to ingest, clean, de-identify and transform multimodal data (video, sensor streams, text). Video data organisation: structure, version and catalogue video datasets so clips, annotations and metadata stay searchable and traceable. Training dataset preparation: assemble balanced, well-documented train, validation and test splits, with clear lineage from raw data to model input. Eval harness: build an automated harness that benchmarks vision-language and NLP models against clinically meaningful metrics, tracks regressions and supports build-vs-buy model decisions. 2. Clinical knowledge base Build the structured clinical knowledge base that turns unstructured input into coded, interoperable records. Database design: design the schema and stand up the data store for clinical concepts and their relationships. Clinical terminologies: ingest and map TC3, SNOMED CT, ICD-10 and related NHS standards, including cross-mappings between them. Natural language processing: extract entities and relationships from clinical text and link them to coded concepts. Document handling: parse and structure clinical documents (PDFs, notes, forms) into the database. Clinical knowledge: work with clinicians to make sure the database reflects real-world clinical reasoning and pre-hospital workflows. By the end of the first 3 months, we'd expect a working eval harness in use for model decisions, a labelled and versioned core dataset, and a first version of the knowledge base linked to the product. What we're looking for We don't expect one person to be expert in everything below. Strong candidates will be deep in one workstream and credible in the other. Must-haves Strong Python and data engineering skills, with a track record of shipping production data or ML pipelines, not just research notebooks. Hands-on experience building ML evaluation frameworks, benchmarks or test harnesses, ideally for vision, video or language models. Experience running data labelling and training-data preparation, including annotation tooling and quality control. Working knowledge of databases and data modelling. Practical NLP experience: entity extraction, entity linking or document parsing. Comfort handling sensitive data under data protection and clinical safety constraints. Pragmatism and speed: you can work with ambiguity, make good build-vs-buy calls and ship in weeks, not quarters. Nice to have Experience with SNOMED CT, ICD-10, dm+d or other NHS clinical terminologies and coding. A background in health-tech, clinical informatics or another regulated domain such as defence. Experience with video data at scale (frame sampling, temporal annotation, multimodal datasets). Familiarity with FHIR or HL7 interoperability standards. Experience working with LLMs and VLMs, including edge or on-device deployment. Early-stage startup experience, especially as a founding or early engineer. Probably not the right fit if You need detailed specs and a large team around you to be effective. You prefer pure research over building tools people use every day. This is a high urgency opening, and we are flexible to consider applicants either on a more flexible consultancy agreement (rolling by mutual agreement, with a competitive day rate); or a long term permanent employment contract with shares as part of the package and scope to grow into a longer-term role as Tricorder builds its engineering team. Project Tricorder — Clinical Infrastructure for Field Operations

We're looking for a hands-on engineer to build two foundations of the Tricorder product: the evaluation harness and training data pipeline behind our AI models, and a clinical knowledge base grounded in tactical combat care, SNOMED CT and ICD-10.

About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/

Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward.

Tricorder builds the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It is a dual-use venture serving defence medical and civilian pre-hospital care.

Our prototype product is already in user testing. Edge AI sits at the core: multimodal language models that turn video, sensor data and clinical notes into patient records, drive predictions and inform data-driven learnings across deployments. To trust those models in the field, we need rigorous data and evaluation - that's where you come in.

What you'll do

You'll own two workstreams, working day to day with the founder and the FF build team.

1. Data pipeline and evaluation harness

Build the data foundations that tell us whether our models are good enough for clinical use.

  • Data labelling: design labelling schemas and guidelines, set up tooling, and run labelling with clinical input, including quality checks and inter-annotator agreement.

  • Data processing: build reproducible pipelines to ingest, clean, de-identify and transform multimodal data (video, sensor streams, text).

  • Video data organisation: structure, version and catalogue video datasets so clips, annotations and metadata stay searchable and traceable.

  • Training dataset preparation: assemble balanced, well-documented train, validation and test splits, with clear lineage from raw data to model input.

  • Eval harness: build an automated harness that benchmarks vision-language and NLP models against clinically meaningful metrics, tracks regressions and supports build-vs-buy model decisions.

2. Clinical knowledge base

Build the structured clinical knowledge base that turns unstructured input into coded, interoperable records.

  • Database design: design the schema and stand up the data store for clinical concepts and their relationships.

  • Clinical terminologies: ingest and map TC3, SNOMED CT, ICD-10 and related NHS standards, including cross-mappings between them.

  • Natural language processing: extract entities and relationships from clinical text and link them to coded concepts.

  • Document handling: parse and structure clinical documents (PDFs, notes, forms) into the database.

  • Clinical knowledge: work with clinicians to make sure the database reflects real-world clinical reasoning and pre-hospital workflows.

By the end of the first 3 months, we'd expect a working eval harness in use for model decisions, a labelled and versioned core dataset, and a first version of the knowledge base linked to the product.

What we're looking for

We don't expect one person to be expert in everything below. Strong candidates will be deep in one workstream and credible in the other.

Must-haves

  • Strong Python and data engineering skills, with a track record of shipping production data or ML pipelines, not just research notebooks.

  • Hands-on experience building ML evaluation frameworks, benchmarks or test harnesses, ideally for vision, video or language models.

  • Experience running data labelling and training-data preparation, including annotation tooling and quality control.

  • Working knowledge of databases and data modelling.

  • Practical NLP experience: entity extraction, entity linking or document parsing.

  • Comfort handling sensitive data under data protection and clinical safety constraints.

  • Pragmatism and speed: you can work with ambiguity, make good build-vs-buy calls and ship in weeks, not quarters.

Nice to have

  • Experience with SNOMED CT, ICD-10, dm+d or other NHS clinical terminologies and coding.

  • A background in health-tech, clinical informatics or another regulated domain such as defence.

  • Experience with video data at scale (frame sampling, temporal annotation, multimodal datasets).

  • Familiarity with FHIR or HL7 interoperability standards.

  • Experience working with LLMs and VLMs, including edge or on-device deployment.

  • Early-stage startup experience, especially as a founding or early engineer.

Probably not the right fit if

  • You need detailed specs and a large team around you to be effective.

  • You prefer pure research over building tools people use every day.

This is a high urgency opening, and we are flexible to consider applicants either on a more flexible consultancy agreement (rolling by mutual agreement, with a competitive day rate); or a long term permanent employment contract with shares as part of the package and scope to grow into a longer-term role as Tricorder builds its engineering team.

raw.description:
We are looking for a ​QC Engineer​ in support to our client Fusion for Energy for their location in ​Barcelona, Spain or Cadarache, France​.  

 

Please note, the successful candidate will be employed by ATG Europe (or one of its subsidiaries). Furthermore, upon selection, they will be subject to a general security screening performed by an external provider (further information will be provided at interview stage). 

 

The successful candidate will be tasked with, but not limited to:

  • Review suppliers’ quality related documents;   

  • Provide support to supervisions and audits performed to suppliers;   

  • Follow up of Non-Conformities and deviations (deviations are changes in the requirement of the contract);   

  • Establish a close communication with suppliers, being supportive achieving a smooth progress of the activities;    

  • Supervise and inspect the manufacturing processes of mechanical components at the suppliers;   

  • Support to the definition, qualification and monitoring of joining techniques (Machining, Welding, Assembly) of various components (materials such as stainless steel, copper, aluminum, etc.);   

  • Monitoring of non-destructive tests carried out in suppliers, including Ultrasound and Radiography. 

At ATG Science & Engineering S.L., we are firmly committed to equal opportunities and respect for diversity. The Equality Plan and active policies promote to foster an inclusive environment, free from discrimination. Regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, handicap (+33% certificado de discapacidad) or any other reason protected by relevant state or municipal legislation, we are pleased to consider all eligible candidates for employment.


Please ensure that your CV clearly explains how you meet these mandatory requirements. If it doesn’t align completely with the essential criteria, it could result in rejection. 

  • Bachelor’s degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, aerospace, or nuclear engineering (or equivalent);   

  • At least 5 years of experience in the manufacturing domain, with involvement in QA and QC activities and experience in supplier supervision/audit; 

  •  Proven experience in: Quality, Audits, and QA procedures;   

  •  Knowledge of quality control (primarily welding and NDT -RT, UT);   

  •  Ability to work both autonomously and in a team;   

  • Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the EU;   

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.    

 

Please submit your application in English via the apply button below. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.

raw.title: Product Engineer
raw.description:
Who We Are

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026.

🎯 The Role

We are looking for a Product Engineer with a strong product mindset to join our engineering team and contribute to the development of our AI-powered platform.

At Inato, being a Product Engineer means more than building features. It means understanding the problems we solve, the needs of our users, and the business challenges behind our decisions.

You will report to an Engineering Manager and work closely with a multidisciplinary team composed of a Product Lead, AI Engineers, and other Product Engineers.

You will take ownership of features throughout their lifecycle, from understanding the problem and challenging assumptions to designing, implementing, and evaluating solutions.

We believe that great products are built through a combination of technical excellence, product thinking, curiosity, and collaboration.

How is this opportunity different?

  • Meaningful impact: Contribute to making clinical trials more accessible and inclusive, with a tangible impact on patients' lives.

  • Product-driven culture: Work on an established SaaS platform alongside a product team that prioritizes business and user impact over the number of features delivered.

  • Intellectual challenges: Solve complex product, business, and engineering problems in an industry where AI plays an increasingly central role.

  • Engineering excellence: Join a team of 15 engineers with a strong culture of technical quality, modern technologies, and continuous improvement.

  • Continuous growth: Develop your technical and product expertise through ownership, learning, initiative, and constructive feedback.

  • Collaborative culture: Work alongside passionate colleagues who value knowledge sharing, mutual support, diverse perspectives, and collective success.

Typical projects you could be working on

  • Integrating Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems to help research sites assess patients against clinical trial eligibility criteria.

  • Building a centralized experience for research site networks, allowing them to apply to trials and assess patients across multiple sites.

  • Collaborating with AI Engineers to integrate AI-powered capabilities into reliable, intuitive, and valuable product experiences.

🚀 Responsibilities

  • Build features from beginning to end: discovery, design, implementation, deployment, and support.

  • Understand user needs and business objectives to challenge assumptions and contribute to product decisions.

  • Balance technical complexity, product value, and long-term maintainability.

  • Leverage AI tools to improve your engineering workflows while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and reliability.

  • Continuously improve our engineering practices, processes, and tools.

  • Learn from your teammates and share your knowledge internally and externally.

🔎 What We Are Looking For

Product & Business Mindset

  • You are genuinely interested in understanding why you are building something, not just how to build it.

  • You take a step back, ask relevant questions, and consider the broader business and user impact of your work.

  • You enjoy collaborating with Product Managers, challenging ideas constructively, and finding pragmatic solutions to complex problems.

Technical Foundations

  • You have 2+ years of professional experience building and maintaining web products within an engineering team, with concrete achievements you can talk about.

  • You have solid software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience with TypeScript and modern web technologies.

  • Ideally, you have a full-stack background with a stronger interest in back-end engineering and software architecture.

  • If your background is primarily front-end, we also welcome applications from engineers who have started exploring back-end development or are genuinely motivated to deepen their expertise in this area.

  • You actively explore and use AI-powered development tools, with a critical understanding of their capabilities and limitations.

Growth & Mindset

  • You are intellectually curious, analytical, and able to quickly grasp new concepts.

  • You actively seek opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and expand your responsibilities.

  • Your career reflects a willingness to progress, explore new areas, and continuously improve your skills.

  • You value constructive feedback, collaboration, and collective success.

Professional Experience

  • You have experience working on a SaaS product, ideally within a growing startup or scaleup, where you have experienced evolving product needs, technical challenges, and organizational growth.

  • You can communicate clearly in both written and spoken English and French.

💻 Our Technical Environment

Explore our current technology stack and the tools we use to build and scale our product on StackShare.

We don't expect you to already master every technology in our stack. We value strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn.

⭐ Bonus

  • Experience with functional programming, particularly in TypeScript.

  • Experience building or integrating AI-powered features into production applications.

  • Previous experience in Healthcare, HealthTech, MedTech, or clinical research.

  • Experience applying software craftsmanship practices to maintain and improve a shared codebase.

  • Experience contributing to the evolution or scaling of a SaaS product.

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply, even if your background does not match every aspect of the role. We value your potential, learning ability, and progression alongside your previous experience.

Employment conditions

  • Contract: Permanent, full-time (CDI)

  • Start date: Flexible

Benefits

A performance marketing agency and freelancers handle part of the day-to-day execution. You'll report to our Growth & Marketing Lead.

The Role

As our Performance Marketer, Acquisition, you'll own paid acquisition and manage more than €15M in annual spend across Meta, Google, TikTok, ChatGPT and new channels. Your job is to turn that spend into seller leads and booked sales meetings.

Our goal is to double seller leads year over year and cut the cost per booked sales meeting by 10%. You'll need to maintain lead quality in a crowded market: Meta and TikTok are starting to compete for the same audiences, and so are Google and ChatGPT.

You'll also help us use AI to manage campaigns, produce ads and analyze performance, so the team can manage more spend and run more tests with the same headcount.

What You'll Be Able to Do in a Year

Ad platforms report clicks and leads. At Zefir, you'll follow those leads through to booked meetings with Sales and use what you learn to decide where to spend.

  • Allocate €15M+ a year by cost per booked meeting. Compare costs across segments and recognise when fewer leads signal better performance.

  • Measure what your campaigns actually add. Design and interpret geo-lift or holdout tests to find out how many extra meetings a campaign generated, and use the results to move budget.

  • Run acquisition with AI. Build your own agents and automations for campaign management, ad production and performance analysis, then measure their impact.

  • Use campaign results to improve creative. Brief and challenge our agency and freelancers, then work with our Content Strategist to turn what you learn into the next round of tests.

What You'll Do

Set the paid acquisition strategy

  • Set quarterly targets with our Growth & Marketing Lead based on how sellers behave, how the market is changing and what competitors are doing.

  • Decide how to split spend across channels and campaigns to hit those targets and keep generating leads at a sustainable cost beyond the quarter.

  • Find and launch new paid channels and lead-generation partnerships.

Own daily performance and the €15M+ budget

  • Optimise campaigns daily with Sales, Brand and Product. When a campaign underperforms, reallocate spend that day.

  • Lead the weekly acquisition review: explain where we missed the plan, what drove the gap and what you'll do to close it.

  • Maximise return on the budget. Use the cost per booked sales meeting in each segment to decide where to put the next euro.

  • Work directly across Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, ChatGPT and new platforms, and know the tracking stack end to end, from Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking to attribution.

  • Work with Sales, Product and Data to understand which sellers book a meeting and why, and use those findings to decide what to test and what to change.

  • Share ownership of paid channels with our Content Strategist: they own the creative angles and assets; you own distribution, budget allocation and performance analysis.

Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

⭐️ The Account Executive (Small Businesses) job

Your mission

Join our Small Businesses team targeting companies with 10-30 employees across tech, consulting, and business services, the market segment where Alan has the strongest product-market fit and brand recognition. You'll work in a high-velocity environment with strong conversion rates, and the opportunity to make an immediate impact on hundreds of growing French companies.

What you'll own

  • Full sales cycle: From prospection to closing

  • Strategic relationships: Drive deals and manage key customer relationships

  • Education & demos: Deliver inspiring product demonstrations and guide stakeholders through the evaluation process

The Alan way of selling

We've developed the Alan Smart & Soft selling method:

  • Smart: Leverage precise messaging and materials to educate and inspire

  • Soft: Create tailored, high-touch strategies for each prospect

  • Experience: Deliver a seamless journey that reflects Alan's customer-first approach

Beyond sales

As an Alan team member, you'll:

  • Shape our product evolution

  • Contribute to improving our methods and strategy

  • Participate in growth initiatives

  • Be part of a collaborative team that thinks big

Join us in revolutionizing healthcare through technology and human connection 🌟

Meet Estelle Berdugo one of our Account Executives.

On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

  • Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent)

  • Have a strong understanding of CRM data models — attribute/event design and data hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Can frame and implement processes for lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, and personalization

  • Have a product knack: you can define what's not working, identify what to build next, and see problems as opportunities to bring more value

  • Bring data fluency and analytical rigor: you read platform and campaign data, surface anomalies, and draw business insights

  • Can be both hands-on and think strategically — you drive the big picture while staying close to execution

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills — you'll partner daily with engineering, product, sales, and marketing teams

  • Can manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment

  • Communicate with excellent written and spoken English

  • Are impact-driven with a strong bias towards improving processes

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Nantes, Biarritz, Annecy, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

raw.title: Marketing Operations
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

  • Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent)

  • Have a strong understanding of CRM data models — attribute/event design and data hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Can frame and implement processes for lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, and personalization

  • Have a product knack: you can define what's not working, identify what to build next, and see problems as opportunities to bring more value

  • Bring data fluency and analytical rigor: you read platform and campaign data, surface anomalies, and draw business insights

  • Can be both hands-on and think strategically — you drive the big picture while staying close to execution

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills — you'll partner daily with engineering, product, sales, and marketing teams

  • Can manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment

  • Communicate with excellent written and spoken English

  • Are impact-driven with a strong bias towards improving processes

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Nantes, Biarritz, Annecy, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Head of Marketing, ET Academy
description: À propos d'ET Academy ET Academy est la formation créée par Eva ----- 347 000 abonnés sur Instagram), créatrice de contenu voyage. Elle apprend aux créatrices à vivre de leur contenu : trouver des marques, décrocher des collaborations rémunérées, lancer leurs propres offres. Nous proposons deux programmes, Formation et Coaching, vendus en appel par notre équipe sales. Notre acquisition repose sur le contenu organique d'Eva (plus de 1,5 million de vues par semaine sur Instagram), sur nos tunnels (VSL, formations gratuites, ressources ManyChat, communauté Skool, live hebdomadaire) et sur la publicité Meta. Le défi Nous générons beaucoup de leads, mais pas assez de leads qualifiés qui passent à l'achat. Ton rôle est de régler ça, sur trois axes : La pertinence des tunnels : chaque étape, de l'opt‑in au rendez‑vous sales, doit attirer et qualifier les bons profils. Le ciblage : identifier les profils qui convertissent vraiment et orienter les audiences en conséquence. L'idéation : créatives publicitaires, structure des contenus, des posts et des stories. Tes missions Ads et acquisition payante Piloter le Business Manager Meta en autonomie : structure des campagnes, audiences, pixel et événements, budget d'environ 5 000 € par mois. Trouver les angles, écrire les scripts et les accroches, produire ou briefer les créas (vidéo, statique, UGC) avec l'appui de l'IA. Tester chaque semaine de nouvelles créas et audiences, couper ce qui ne marche pas, scaler ce qui marche. Affiner le ciblage sur les profils qui achètent vraiment, à partir des retours de l'équipe sales et des données CRM. Contenu et organique Construire la ligne éditoriale avec Eva : piliers de contenu, formats, fréquence de publication. Structurer les Reels, carrousels et posts : idées, accroches, scripts, CTA et mots‑clés ManyChat. Structurer et publier les stories chaque jour : séquences, sondages, preuves sociales, appels à l'action vers nos tunnels. Préparer et animer chaque semaine le live avec Eva : thème, déroulé, promotion en amont, relance des inscrites. Analyser les performances des contenus pour reproduire ce qui fonctionne. Tunnels et qualification Auditer chaque tunnel (VSL, formations gratuites, ressources, pages d'opt‑in, questions de qualification) et prioriser les améliorations. Tester de nouvelles pages, de nouveaux messages et de nouvelles questions de qualification. Travailler main dans la main avec le Head of Sales sur la qualité des leads, le taux de prise de rendez‑vous et le taux de présence aux appels. Automatiser ce qui peut l'être (ManyChat, emails, relances) en tirant parti de l'IA, notamment Claude. Tracking, data et attribution Mettre en place un tracking très précis de bout en bout, du contenu et des ads jusqu'aux tunnels, au setting et au closing, pour attribuer chaque vente à sa vraie source. Suivre les performances de chaque tunnel : coût par lead, taux de qualification, prise de rendez‑vous, présence, closing. Construire et tenir le reporting marketing, et le présenter chaque semaine à l'équipe. Repérer dans les données les leviers d'optimisation, les prioriser et les mettre en œuvre. Ton profil Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en marketing d'acquisition, idéalement dans l'infoproduit, le coaching ou la création de contenu. Tu as déjà géré un Business Manager Meta et des budgets publicitaires, avec des résultats chiffrés à montrer. Tu sais imaginer des créas et des contenus qui performent. Tu comprends un tunnel de vente de bout en bout et tu maîtrises le tracking (pixel, UTM, CRM). Tu prends des initiatives sans attendre qu'on te le demande. Tu innoves et tu proposes sans cesse de nouvelles idées à tester. Tu es très organisé : priorités claires, process, suivi rigoureux. Tu es autonome, à l'aise avec les chiffres et les outils d'IA. Tu parles français couramment. Ce qu'on te propose Un poste à temps plein ou quasi temps plein, 100 % en télétravail. On cherche quelqu'un de vraiment disponible pour tout ce qu'il y a à faire. Une mission sans durée limitée, avec un démarrage début décembre 2026. Une rémunération au‑dessus du marché, avec une part variable liée à la performance. Une petite équipe soudée et orientée résultats, en lien direct avec Eva et la direction. Le process Candidature sur Join : CV et exemples de campagnes ou de contenus, avec leurs résultats. Test pratique : une mise en situation concrète sur nos vrais enjeux (tunnels, créas, contenus), pour voir comment tu réfléchis et comment tu travailles. Call avec Eva et Pierre , les responsables de la formation. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Product Owner (H/F/N)
raw.description:
Les entreprises qui performent décident mieux. Depuis 2006, Ekimetrics aide les organisations à transformer leurs décisions en avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à des solutions d’IA. Notre double ambition est d’allier performance et durabilité, pour construire un leadership pérenne. 

Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation. 

Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN. 

Vous rejoignez l’équipe Produit – R&PD 

Au sein de l’équipe R&PD (Research & Product Development) nous concevons et industrialisons des solutions Data & IA SaaS à fort impact business, qui répondent aux enjeux de nos clients grâce à l’analytics, la data science et l’intelligence artificielle.

A ce titre, nous recrutons un·e Product Owner pour notre solution Marketing Effectiveness avec pour objectif de structurer la  roadmap produit, maximiser son adoption, son time-to-market et la valeur délivrée à nos clients. 

Votre rôle dans l’équipe 

Product Owner de notre solution Marketing Effectiveness (Eki.Decisions), vous transformez les besoins business, marché et utilisateurs en fonctionnalités concrètes, documentées et alignées sur une logique de plateforme commune. 

Vous travaillez au quotidien avec le Product Manager, les équipes engineering et data, ainsi que les équipes projet et delivery, pour construire une solution fiable, adoptée et scalable. 

Vos principales missions 

Piloter le backlog et le delivery 

  • Structurer, prioriser et maintenir le backlog de la solution 

  • Rédiger les user stories, spécifications fonctionnelles et critères d’acceptance 

  • Clarifier les besoins avec l’engineering et accompagner chaque livraison de bout en bout 

  • Suivre l’avancement, lever les blocages et sécuriser les engagements 

  • Animer les rituels agiles : refinement, sprint planning, reviews, rétrospectives, synchronisations produit/tech 

  • Rendre la roadmap, les priorités et les arbitrages lisibles pour toutes les parties prenantes 

Contribuer à la vision produit 

  • Co-construire la vision et la roadmap avec le Product Manager 

  • Traduire les enjeux business et marché en opportunités produit concrètes : fonctionnalités, parcours utilisateurs, briques mutualisées, standards d’expérience 

  • Prioriser selon la valeur business, l’impact client, la contribution à la platformisation et la capacité à accélérer le time-to-market 

Participer à la product discovery 

  • Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs et des clients sur le Marketing Effectiveness 

  • Maîtriser les usages, comportements et règles métier qui font la valeur de la solution 

  • Identifier les enjeux fonctionnels et opérationnels : expérience utilisateur, cohérence des parcours, adoption, scalabilité, industrialisation 

  • Conduire ou contribuer aux activités de discovery : interviews, retours terrain, analyses d’usage, benchmarks 

Faire adopter et améliorer en continu 

  • Accompagner le déploiement des nouvelles fonctionnalités auprès des parties prenantes clés, avec une communication claire sur ce qui est livré 

  • Mesurer l’impact : adoption, satisfaction, valeur délivrée aux clients 

  • Animer la boucle de feedback avec les équipes Produit, Business, Tech et Delivery 

  • S’appuyer sur les outils de tracking pour monitorer les usages et prioriser de façon data-driven 

  • Garantir la qualité : documentation produit, release notes, support, monitoring d’usage 

Collaborer en transverse 

  • Travailler avec les équipes Produit, Tech, Data, IA et Delivery pour assurer la cohérence des solutions émergentes avec la plateforme 

  • Servir de relais entre les équipes business, produit, engineering et delivery 

  • Participer aux démonstrations, formations internes, retours d’expérience et communications produit 

Votre profil 

Expérience 

  • 3 ans minimum en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager 

  • Expérience sur des produits SaaS ou digitaux, idéalement dans un environnement data, IA ou tech

Compétences 

  • Forte appétence business : vous reliez les fonctionnalités à la valeur client et aux enjeux marché 

  • Aisance avec les profils tech : vous comprenez les enjeux d’un produit technique, sans avoir besoin d’être développeur·se 

  • Maîtrise du backlog : clarifier les besoins, prioriser des sujets complexes, suivre le delivery 

  • Logique de plateforme : mutualisation des usages, convergence des solutions, cohérence des parcours 

  • Sensibilité forte à l’expérience utilisateur, à l’adoption et à la qualité produit 

  • Capacité à vulgariser et à embarquer les parties prenantes autour d’une vision commune 

Savoir-être 

  • Organisé·e, rigoureux·se, autonome, curieux·se et orienté·e impact 

Langues 

  • Français et anglais courants, à l’écrit comme à l’oral 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?  

Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent: à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 

Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.

Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.

En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.

Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 ! Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.  

Vous aurez accès :

  • Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School.
  • A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People.
  • De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté.
  • Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards).
  • Une politique de télétravail flexible, avec 3 jours de présence obligatoire par tranche de 15 jours.
 

En tant qu’employeur, Ekimetrics offre à tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi sans distinction de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge. Ekimetrics veille à développer un environnement de travail inclusif qui reflète la diversité dans ses équipes.

Title:                                       Systems and Digital Solutions Intern

Type of contract:                   Paid internship

Contract duration:                 6 months   

Work time:                             Full-time (40 hours per week) or part-time

Reporting to:                         Systems and Digital Solutions Coordinator

Technical guidance:              BI and Systems Officer

Location:                                Remote (home-based outside Switzerland)

Start date:                              January 2027

Application deadline:           10/12/2026

 

Background

The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) was launched in October 2019 by Dr Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad, 2018 Nobel Peace Prize laureates. Its mission is to enhance access to reparations for survivors of conflict-related sexual violence around the globe, thus responding to a gap long identified by survivors. GSF acts to provide interim reparative measures in situations where states or other parties are unable or unwilling to meet their responsibilities. GSF advocates for duty-bearers and the international community to develop reparations programmes. It also guides states and civil society by providing expertise and technical support for designing reparations programmes. GSF’s survivor-centric approach is the cornerstone of its work.

 

Role Summary

The Systems & Digital Solutions Intern provides part-time operational support across GSF’s systems, business intelligence, data quality, information management and IT support services. The intern contributes to first-line user assistance, routine administration, testing, documentation, data cleansing and validation, and the organisation of information within GSF Online, SharePoint and other approved systems. Assignments are prioritised through a six-month work plan and include a structured handover to support continuity between successive internship placements.

 

Position Responsibilities

Systems and User Support

  • Provide first-line support for GSF Online and other assigned systems, record support requests and contribute to an initial response within one business day;

  • Support routine user-account and access administration under supervision, including approved access requests and periodic access reviews;

  • Assist with system configuration, testing, issue reproduction and validation of fixes or new releases;

  • Escalate unresolved, recurring, security-related or access-control issues promptly.

Data Quality and Information Management

  • Support data cleansing, migration, validation and follow-up of identified data-quality issues;

  • Assist with routine data preparation and testing of Power BI dashboards and reporting outputs under technical guidance;

  • Support consistent organisation of information in SharePoint, GSF Online and other approved systems, including naming, storage and permissions;

  • Maintain clear records of completed checks, identified issues and follow-up actions.

Documentation, Training and Continuity

  • Prepare and update user guides, FAQs, process documentation and training materials;

  • Support system demonstrations, training sessions and user-adoption activities;

  • Complete priority assignments agreed through the six-month work plan and provide regular progress updates;

  • Prepare a structured handover of open tasks, documentation and learning for the next internship placement.

 

Position Requirements

Education and Experience

  • The position is open to students currently enrolled in a master’s program in information systems, data science, computer science, business analytics or a related field. Please note a tripartite agreement is mandatory for this internship;

  • Interest or initial experience in business systems, data quality, reporting, user support or information management;

  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365; experience with Power BI, SharePoint or similar platforms is an asset.

Other Requirements

  • Good written and spoken English; French or another GSF working language is an asset.

  • Analytical, organised and service-oriented approach, with attention to detail and confidentiality;

  • Ability to learn quickly, document work clearly and escalate issues appropriately;

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural and predominantly remote environment;

  • Commitment to GSF’s survivor-centred values, safeguarding, inclusion, accountability and responsible use of data and technology.

 

 

How to apply

Please click apply to submit your application by 10th December 2026 (midnight CET).

Kindly note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 

____________________________________________________________________________________

The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) is dedicated to fostering diversity, gender balance, and inclusion, reflecting the varied landscapes where we operate and the communities we work with. We welcome applications from qualified professionals of all backgrounds, cultures, and beliefs. We particularly encourage candidates from regions where GSF is active to apply.

At GSF, we are committed to enforcing stringent Safeguarding policies, covering protection from exploitation, abuse, harassment, misuse of power, and discrimination, as well as child safeguarding and financial and fiscal integrity. We uphold a zero-tolerance approach to any form of unacceptable behaviour.

As part of our recruitment process, shortlisted candidates will be required to provide references from previous employers and complete a self-declaration.

GSF does not charge a processing fee at any stage of its recruitment, selection, or hiring processes (i.e. application stage, interview stage, validation stage, appointment, or training). GSF will never request applicants’ bank account information.

 

Please note that candidates must be authorised to work in the country where the position is based at the time of application.

 

Your Data - If you choose to apply for this position, you will be providing us with your personal data, which will be processed solely for the purpose of selecting a candidate for this position. raw.description:
About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:
We’re looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to build and scale the operational engine behind DeepJudge’s marketing and qualified pipeline growth.

This is a builder role for someone who can design, implement, and own the lifecycle, scoring, routing, campaign and attribution systems. You’ll act as a strategic and operational business partner to Content, Field, Demand Gen and Product Marketing, and work with Sales, RevOps and Partnerships to make sure every lead and target account reaches the right seller, and that we know which programs created the pipeline.

If you naturally think: “Which campaign actually created this opportunity, and why did it take three days to reach a rep?” …you’ll likely be a strong fit. You will play a key role in giving our growing sales team a reliable flow of qualified pipeline and in driving commercial success.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Lead and account lifecycle

    • Own the lead and account lifecycle from first touch to sales-qualified opportunity, including lifecycle stages, MQL/SQL definitions and SLAs

    • Design and maintain lead scoring, inbound routing and assignment rules as the marketing and sales team grows

    • Run the Marketing-to-Sales handoff with clear acceptance criteria and feedback loops

  • Campaign, event and partner marketing operations

    • Administer HubSpot Marketing Hub and its integrations with ad, event and enrichment tools

    • Operationalize field and growth marketing: event lead capture, ABM programs, nurture workflows and partner campaigns

    • Own campaign attribution and pipeline source reporting

  • AI, automation, and marketing innovation

    • Identify, test and roll out AI tools and automations that measurably improve marketing performance, scalability and efficiency.

    • Build workflows connecting intent signals, enrichment, CRM, landing pages and advertising platforms, to power ABM and personalized campaigns at scale, in partnership with Demand Generation.

    • Turn successful experiments into repeatable processes, partnering with our GTM Engineer on complex integrations and shared technical infrastructure.

    • Partner with Demand Generation to scale campaigns through AI-assisted segmentation, dynamic landing pages and targeted advertising.

    • Experiment with emerging GTM technologies and turn successful prototypes into repeatable marketing processes.

  • Attribution and performance

    • Own campaigns and marketing attribution frameworks and pipeline source reporting.

    • Build and maintain marketing funnel dashboard, in terms of volume, stage conversion, velocity and campaign ROI.

    • Analyze marketing funnel performance and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and campaign effectiveness.

  • Data quality and business partnership

    • Set and enforce marketing data standards: hygiene, enrichment, deduplication and consent management

    • Act as Operational business partner to Marketing, Sales and CSM, Partnership leadership

What success looks like in 12 months:

  • Every inbound lead and target account reaches the right owner within an agreed SLA

  • Marketing and Sales work from one shared set of lifecycle definitions and with a trusted MQL/SQL handoff

  • Field and Demand Gen spend measurably less time on admin because they can rely on an efficient system from lead to SQL

  • Leadership can see which campaigns, events and partners touched and created pipeline

  • Marketing data completeness and accuracy support leadership decision making

  • AI-powered workflows run in production across ABM and lifecycle marketing, with measurable gains in efficiency or performance

You're a great fit if you:

  • Have 4+ years in Marketing Operations or Demand Generation Operations in B2B SaaS, including time at a high-growth company

  • Have deep hands-on expertise in HubSpot Marketing Hub administration (Marketo or Pardot also considered)

  • Have a proven track record designing lead lifecycle, scoring and routing for a sales team that scaled

  • Have experience building campaign attribution and pipeline source reporting

  • Have hands-on experience building automations and enrichment workflows (e.g. Clay, Zapier/n8n, ZoomInfo/Apollo, intent data)

  • Bring an analytical mindset with comfort in funnel math and data quality work

  • Have excellent stakeholder management across GTM teams

What you can look forward to:

  • Owning the marketing operations engine that supports marketing and feeds a growing sales team
