title: Senior Software Engineer (Python, Telecom)
description: Für einen Kunden suchen wir einen Senior Software Engineer mit fundiertem Python- und Telekommunikations-Know-how. Du entwickelst eine Plattform weiter, die die Bereitstellung und Inbetriebnahme von Telekommunikationsdiensten über mehrere Netzdomänen hinweg automatisiert. Als Stellvertretung des Technical Leads koordinierst du die technische Umsetzung im Team und begleitest Lösungen vom Architekturentscheid bis in den Betrieb. Den Multi-Domain Service Orchestrator (MDSO) auf Basis von HPE Telco Service Orchestrator und Python-Microservices weiterentwickeln. TM-Forum-basierte Servicemodelle, intent-basierte Orchestrierungslogik und wiederverwendbare Funktionen für Datennetze, Netzinventar, IP-Management, Mobilfunk inklusive FRMCS und Datacenter entwickeln. Asynchrone Python-Services, REST APIs mit OpenAPI-Spezifikationen sowie ereignisgesteuerte Integrationen mit Kafka und TM Forum APIs implementieren. Den Technical Lead vertreten, Architekturentscheidungen in technische Designs überführen und diese auf Teamebene verantworten und freigeben. Engineering-Standards definieren, Code- und Design-Reviews durchführen, Engineers coachen und Lösungen externer Lieferanten und Systemintegratoren technisch beurteilen. Automatisierte Tests entwickeln, an CI/CD-Pipelines mit Git, Tekton, Argo CD und OpenShift mitarbeiten und andere Telecom-Teams bei der Umsetzung von Automatisierungsvorhaben unterstützen. Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Software Engineering auf Senior-Level mit ausgezeichneten Python-Kenntnissen und fundierter Praxis mit asynchronem Python, FastAPI, Pydantic und pytest. Fundierte Erfahrung mit REST und OpenAPI, verteilten Microservice-Architekturen, komplexen Systemintegrationen und ereignisgesteuerten Integrationen mit Kafka. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb containerisierter Services auf OpenShift oder Kubernetes sowie mit Git und CI/CD. Erfahrung mit intent-basierter und modellgetriebener Service-Orchestrierung, sehr gute Kenntnisse der TM Forum APIs und ein sehr gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Produkte, Services und Ressourcen modelliert und zerlegt werden. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit technischen Designs, Code- und Design-Reviews, Engineering-Standards und Mentoring sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit System- oder Solution-Architekten. Fähigkeit, technische Lösungen von Lieferanten und Systemintegratoren kritisch zu beurteilen und Feedback konstruktiv zu vermitteln. Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, Kommunikationsstärke und lösungsorientiertes Arbeiten. Fundierte Erfahrung mit agilen Arbeitsweisen und SAFe. Deutsch auf Niveau C1 und Englisch auf Niveau B2. Praxis mit HPE Telco Service Orchestrator oder vergleichbaren Plattformen wie Cisco NSO oder Ciena Blue Planet. (von Vorteil) Kenntnisse von TM Forum SID und ODA, Telecom-OSS-Architekturen und Multi-Vendor-Umgebungen. (von Vorteil) Verständnis von IP, VLANs, VRFs, Layer 2/3, Routing und MPLS sowie Erfahrung mit Network Inventory oder IPAM. (von Vorteil) Kenntnisse von YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF oder gNMI. (von Vorteil) Erfahrung mit Tekton, Argo CD, Helm, Ansible, API Management oder Java. (von Vorteil) Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Informatik oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung. title: HTS Testing Engineer
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. TEAM & ROLE Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION Impact: Your work will directly shape the magnets that enable commercial fusion energy. Ownership: As an early member of a growing team, you’ll help define how we test HTS at scale. Development: Build specialist skills at the cutting edge of superconducting magnet technology. WHAT YOU WILL DO 1. Qualification at Scale Test Planning: Define test strategies, sampling plans and pass/fail criteria for HTS tapes and cables, and help set up production testing at our Magnet Factory. Measurement: Commission test systems and develop measurement processes that ensure reproducible, traceable measurements of critical current (Ic) and related properties, including the effects of manufacturing processes. Data & Statistics: Help design our HTS test database, with traceability from supplier and reel through to cable, and turn results into statistical datasets for magnet modelling and design. Supplier Selection: Compare supplier data with our own measurements and support decisions on which tapes to use in Alpha and future stellarators. 2. R&D HTS Qualification: Run tape and cable qualification test campaigns, both in-house and at external facilities. Analysis & Reporting: Compare results with models and give clear technical recommendations to the design, modelling and manufacturing teams. Equipment Development: Support the development of new test equipment and methods with external partners. 3. Planning, Safety & Team Planning: Plan test campaigns in line with tape deliveries and the Alpha build programme. Technician Guidance: Write procedures and guide the technicians who run routine tests. Safety: Ensure safe work with cryogens, high currents and high magnetic fields. Quality: Ensure results are traceable, well documented and reproducible. WHO YOU ARE An engineer or scientist who enjoys careful, hands-on experimental work as much as planning how we test at scale. You hold an MSc or PhD in Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

TEAM & ROLE

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Impact: Your work will directly shape the magnets that enable commercial fusion energy.

  • Ownership: As an early member of a growing team, you’ll help define how we test HTS at scale.

  • Development: Build specialist skills at the cutting edge of superconducting magnet technology.


    WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Qualification at Scale

  • Test Planning: Define test strategies, sampling plans and pass/fail criteria for HTS tapes and cables, and help set up production testing at our Magnet Factory.

  • Measurement: Commission test systems and develop measurement processes that ensure reproducible, traceable measurements of critical current (Ic) and related properties, including the effects of manufacturing processes.

  • Data & Statistics: Help design our HTS test database, with traceability from supplier and reel through to cable, and turn results into statistical datasets for magnet modelling and design.

  • Supplier Selection: Compare supplier data with our own measurements and support decisions on which tapes to use in Alpha and future stellarators.

2. R&D

  • HTS Qualification: Run tape and cable qualification test campaigns, both in-house and at external facilities.

  • Analysis & Reporting: Compare results with models and give clear technical recommendations to the design, modelling and manufacturing teams.

  • Equipment Development: Support the development of new test equipment and methods with external partners.

3. Planning, Safety & Team

  • Planning: Plan test campaigns in line with tape deliveries and the Alpha build programme.

  • Technician Guidance: Write procedures and guide the technicians who run routine tests.

  • Safety: Ensure safe work with cryogens, high currents and high magnetic fields.

  • Quality: Ensure results are traceable, well documented and reproducible.

An engineer or scientist who enjoys careful, hands-on experimental work as much as planning how we test at scale.

description: Rotterdam - Als Manager Data-analyse Nieuwsmedia ben je een analytisch sterk en verantwoordelijk voor inhoudelijke inzichten binnen het cluster AD.nl en de 7 regiotitels, zoals De Stentor of De Gelderlander. Je realiseert duurzame digitale groei door de inzichten strategisch te verankeren in de dagelijkse werking van de redacties. Je fungeert als de onmisbare schakel tussen centrale teams en de lokale redacties. Je zit in het team Redactionele Inzichten & Groei (RI&G) en rapporteert aan de Director RI&G. Wie zijn wij? Wij zijn de afdeling Redactionele inzichten & groei (RI&G). Binnen de divisie Nieuwsmedia & Magazines zijn wij de rechterhand voor de hoofdredacties mbt inhoudelijke inzichten en strategie. Met data-analyses, actieplannen en implementaties realiseren we duurzame digitale groei op de redacties. Zo helpen we de redacties om redactionele en operationele kansen in één oogopslag te signaleren en bepalen we samen de digitale koers van onze nieuwsmerken.  Wat ga je doen? Cluster-verantwoordelijkheid: Je beheert de roadmap voor het gehele cluster AD + regiotitels en bepaalt welke projecten en centrale data-innovaties prioriteit krijgen. Team lead & Coaching: Je geeft direct leiding aan een team van 8 lokale analisten, coacht hen in hun rol als strategisch partner voor titels en bevordert de zelfredzaamheid van de redacties. Deze analisten werken op de verschillende redacties verspreid doorheen het land. Strategisch filter: Je fungeert als de 'brug' en het filter voor ad-hoc vragen vanuit de redactie en distribueert deze efficiënt binnen het team om de focus op impact te bewaken. Analytisch expert: Je voert zelfstandig complexe, zwaardere clusterbrede analyses en strategische deep-dives uit die specifiek voor het cluster zijn bedoeld. Netwerkfunctie: Je stemt clusteroverstijgende prioriteiten af met het centrale team, de andere leads en de verschillende hoofdredacties binnen jouw cluster. Wat maak jou de ideale kandidaat? Je hebt een WO / HBO+ denkniveau en 5+ jaar ervaring in data-analyse en strategie mét grote affiniteit voor media. Je beschikt over analytisch en strategisch meesterschap, waardoor je redactionele of operationele kansen signaleert en complexe datasets vertaalt naar een helder, strategisch verhaal. Je hebt ervaring met het direct en indirect aansturen van een team en krijgt energie van coachend leiderschap om de effectieve samenwerking te bevorderen. Je bent besluitvaardig en durft harde prioriteiten te stellen en keuzes richting hoofdredacties te verdedigen. Je hebt een sterke communicatieve kracht en schakelt moeiteloos tussen de diepgaande taal van data-analisten en de strategische behoeften van hoofdredacties en directie. Je bent hands-on en nog steeds zeer vaardig met analytische tools. Jouw standplaats is Rotterdam en je bent bereid om te reizen naar de regionale titels van ADR (van Middelburg tot Enschede). Wat krijg je van ons? 💰 Een salaris passend bij jouw werkervaring en expertise, met een indicatie tussen € 5.500 en € 7.000 bruto per maand. 📝 Een 36-urige werkweek. 💰 8% vakantiegeld en 4% persoonlijk keuzebudget. 🎓 Ruimte om je te ontwikkelen, zowel op de job als online via onze DPG Campus. 🎉 Mogelijkheid om je eigen culturele feestdagen af te stemmen. Solliciteren, en dan? Heb je interesse? Wil je eerst meer informatie? Neem dan gerust contact op met Julia van EL: Nog meer redenen om bij DPG Media te willen werken Bij DPG Media werken we voor meer dan 90 sterke nieuwsmerken, magazines, televisieprogramma’s, radiostations en online services zoals Qmusic, NU.nl , Tweakers, Libelle, VTM en meer. We bereiken maandelijks ruim 90% van de Nederlanders en 8 op de 10 Vlamingen.  We bieden je een professionele werkomgeving waarin we vrijheid enorm belangrijk vinden. We geven je alle ruimte om aan je toekomst te werken door het aanbieden van workshops en trainingen. Voel je vrij om bij ons ondernemer, leerling en teamspeler te zijn, en vooral om jezelf te zijn. Bij DPG Media is iedereen welkom. Dus solliciteer, wat je achtergrond ook is. Er staan ruim 5.500 slimme collega’s te popelen om je op te nemen in een team, of dat nou een projectteam, een pubquizteam of een sportteam is.  Ontdek wat wij je te bieden hebben . description: We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices. Why DataSnipper? The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. What You Will Do Own AI-specific security as a discipline at DataSnipper: identify, assess, and mitigate the risks unique to LLM-based and agentic systems across our products and platform. Translate security policies and risk requirements into concrete technical controls, standards, and guardrails, in partnership with Legal and technical teams. Build a proactive AI security practice grounded in frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the broader OWASP GenAI Security Project (including agentic security), MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and adapt them to how we build. Threat model our agentic features and pipelines, covering prompt injection, sensitive information disclosure, data and model poisoning, insecure output handling, excessive agency, supply-chain risk, and unsafe tool and API use. Red team our AI systems, probing models, prompts, agents, and integrations for weaknesses before attackers do, and turn findings into concrete fixes and guardrails. Design and help implement guardrails, input/output validation, sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and monitoring for AI and agent behavior. Embed security into how we build AI, shifting security left through secure-by-design guidance, secure SDLC practices, and design and code reviews for AI features. Partner with product and engineering teams to make secure AI the default, providing patterns, tooling, and guidance rather than after-the-fact gatekeeping. Strengthen our overall security engineering posture alongside the SRE team, contributing to our SOC 2 and compliance efforts (e.g. via Vanta), CI/CD security gates, and the principle that vulnerable code cannot get deployed. Own our vulnerability management process: identify and prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk, drive remediation across engineering and platform teams, track findings to closure, and fix recurring findings at the root. Strengthen identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption across our products and platform, including the credentials and access that agents and AI integrations depend on. Establish detection, logging, and incident response practices for AI-specific threats, and help the team respond when they occur. Stay ahead of a rapidly evolving threat landscape and continuously raise the bar for how we secure AI. Promote secure development practices through developer guidance and trainings, awareness initiatives, and collaboration with engineering teams. What You Bring Minimum 5 years of experience in security engineering, application security, or a closely related field, with a track record of owning security work end to end in production. Strong grounding in application and cloud security fundamentals: threat modeling, secure design, common vulnerability classes, and secure SDLC practices. Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, API Security, Threat Modeling and Vulnerability Management. Hands-on experience with identity and access management, secrets management, and encryption implementations. Demonstrated interest and hands-on experience in AI/LLM security, whether through professional work, research, red teaming, CTFs, or personal projects, and familiarity with frameworks like the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications or MITRE ATLAS. Solid understanding of how LLM-based and agentic systems work in practice, including prompts, tool/function calling, retrieval, and agent orchestration, and where they break. Proficiency in a scripting or programming language (Python preferred) to build tooling, automate checks, and prototype mitigations. Experience securing cloud-native systems, ideally on Azure, including CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub) and infrastructure-as-code. A proactive, builder mindset; you prevent problems by shipping guardrails and enabling teams, not just by finding issues. Strong communication skills; able to explain AI-specific risks and tradeoffs to engineers, product managers, and leadership. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-moving scale-up, set technical direction, influence without authority, and mentor other engineers while defining a practice that doesn't yet have a playbook. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience red teaming or pentesting AI/LLM systems. Familiarity with the OWASP GenAI Security Project's agentic security work and emerging standards for securing autonomous agents. Experience with AI security tooling such as guardrail frameworks, LLM firewalls, prompt-injection scanners, or AI red-teaming tools. Experience implementing security controls in production agentic systems, including sandboxing, least-privilege tool access, and runtime monitoring. Familiarity with compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and tools like Vanta. Experience with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g. Grafana). Relevant security certifications (e.g. OSCP, GIAC, or AI-security-specific credentials). Experience in fintech, audit technology, or other regulated, trust-sensitive domains. Familiarity with responsible AI, model governance, or AI safety concepts. title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
description: About Us Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. The Role We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organisation. You'll run the complex analysis and modelling behind target setting and annual planning for the entire commercial organisation. You will also help the Director set and execute the revenue analytics strategy, and run the insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business. As you ramp up, you will take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations. We are looking for someone with very strong analytical and modelling skills, which are the foundation of the role, especially in your first two quarters. Just as important, we want someone who is commercially minded and keen to grow into a generalist role, broadening from there into revenue insights and forecasting. What You’ll Do First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards. First 180 days: Lead the analysis for the annual planning and target-setting cycle, and automate the core of revenue reporting and insights with AI tooling. First 12 months: Take on co-ownership of the forecasting cadence with the Director of Revenue Operations. What Will You Be Doing? Run Complex Modelling & Analysis Run complex analysis and modelling to support target setting and the annual planning process for the entire commercial organisation, made up of around 600 commercial roles across SDRs, AEs and Account Managers. Build and maintain the models behind target setting: capacity, quota and productivity assumptions, and territory and segment allocation. Frame the key planning questions, choose the method, pressure-test scenarios and sensitivities, and deliver clear recommendations to revenue leadership, explaining the trade-offs in plain language. Work as the senior analytical partner to the other analyst on the team: stay hands-on in the models while setting the quality bar and documentation standards, so each planning cycle is repeatable and auditable. Build the Revenue Analytics Strategy Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order. Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan. Own execution of that plan: build and maintain the core dashboards and reports that revenue leadership and the wider commercial organisation rely on. Launch and run a recurring insights digest for revenue leaders, turning dashboards and data into a clear narrative — what changed, why it matters, what to do about it. Bring a point of view on what's worth building versus what's noise, and be willing to push back on requests that don't earn their keep. Grow Into Forecasting Co-run the forecasting cadence with sales leaders and the Director of Revenue Operations — forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and accuracy tracking. Build and refine forecasting models based on pipeline, productivity, and historical conversion. Conduct strategic analyses to determine forecasting trends and identify opportunities for process improvement. What You’ll Bring Strong experience in Revenue or Sales Operations, preferably in a SaaS or technology company operating at a global or European level. Advanced modelling and scenario analysis skills (spreadsheets and SQL), ideally with experience in target setting, capacity planning or annual planning for a large commercial organisation. Solid Salesforce reporting skills and working fluency in a BI tool (Looker or equivalent), with a practical, business-first approach to data. Commercial judgement and exposure to quota-carrying teams such as Account Executives, plus a generalist mindset: as comfortable building a dashboard as a planning model or running a forecasting call. The ability to influence sales leadership and revenue executives, and to own ambiguous problems end to end, from framing the question to landing the recommendation. Excellent written communication, since the insights digest is a core, ongoing deliverable of this role. Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate analysis and reporting, or a clear appetite to build that skill quickly. What We Offer 25 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays. An optional pension scheme to support your long-term financial wellbeing. A tax-efficient bike leasing scheme through Lease a Bike, for your commute or personal use. Reimbursed commuting costs if you live more than 10km away from the office. Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk. Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party. Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones. Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about. Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected. A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk. Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs. AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes. How We Work At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work. For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume. Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you. Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate. #LI-Hybrid Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
raw.description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started.

Our Mission

For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry.

The Fulfilment & Express Team

The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world.

About the Role

As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead.

What would YOU be doing?

  • Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why

  • Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed

  • Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers

  • Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup

  • Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers

  • Improving the delivery experience through carrier and rate/transit integrations, consolidation, last-mile cost and efficiency, and clear order visibility for buyers

  • Translating hub operations, carrier behaviour, customs and supplier handling into clear product requirements, designing for the exceptions as much as the happy path

  • Turning support tickets, delay breaches, supplier performance data and customer feedback into prioritised problems, then deciding what to build, buy or fix operationally

  • Partnering daily with Engineering and Design, and closely with Operations, Customer Support, Account Management, Sales, Supplier Experience and Fintech so delivery, credit and payments feel like one journey for the buyer

  • Writing sharp PRDs and decision records, and reporting progress openly through our weekly updates

  • Mentoring other product managers and designers on working in operationally complex domains

What do we need from YOU?

  • 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end

  • Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs

  • Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases

  • Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next

  • Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones

  • Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy

  • Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome

Nice to have

  • Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience

  • Marketplace or B2B commerce experience, ideally two-sided with supply and demand constraints

  • Experience with carrier or shipping APIs, rate and transit tools, 3PL integrations, inventory systems or RFID

  • Experience building predictive or SLA-based estimates, such as delivery dates or ETAs

  • Experience with cross-border shipping, customs, duties or compliance (for example hallmarking and HS codes)


Our culture and what we offer

Nivoda is collaborative, high-growth and built on empowerment. You will have real ownership from day one, a team that wants you to succeed, and the chance to keep learning as the company scales. We are remote-first with flexible hours, and we trust you to do your best work your way.


Our current benefits

  • ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 🩺 Private health insurance

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 🚀 The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase


Equal opportunity

Nivoda is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from everyone. Even if you do not meet 100% of our musts, do not let it stop you. If this role excites you, we would love to hear from you.

Compensation: $180K – $225K • Offers Equity

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en aan die kennis bouwen we bij Lefebvre Sdu al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die zorgt dat alles wat we bouwen veilig en soepel live gaat. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT GenIA-L schuift steeds verder het dagelijkse werk van juristen en fiscalisten in, en dat vraagt om een platform dat soepel meebeweegt. Onze developers willen snel bouwen en veilig live gaan, zonder uren kwijt te zijn aan pipelines en repository-setup. Daar zorg jij voor. Onze infrastructuur draait op AWS, met Kubernetes via EKS, Terraform en Helm, en onze CI/CD loopt via GitHub Actions. In die pipelines borg jij bij elke release de secure coding-eisen van ISO 27001, van SAST en security scanning tot code quality checks en de OWASP Top 10. Nu ligt DevOps nog bij een extern team van 4 engineers. Binnen een jaar willen we die kennis volledig zelf in huis hebben, en daarin speel jij een hoofdrol. Je wordt het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de developers in Product & Technology, brengt structuur in hoe het team werkt en bouwt mee aan de volgende stappen, zoals de overstap van Helm naar ArgoCD. Je weet dat het gelukt is als de andere teams merkbaar minder tijd kwijt zijn aan hun deployments, de infrastructuur gezond is en je precies ziet wat er gebeurt. En als DevOps voelt als een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van Product & Technology. De stack staat en de ambitie is helder. Wat nu nog ontbreekt, is het team dat dit zelf gaat dragen, en dat bouw jij mee op. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent een DevOps engineer die het liefst dicht bij de developers zit. Je bouwt een platform waar anderen zelf mee verder kunnen, vindt het vanzelfsprekend dat security in elke pipeline is ingebouwd en brengt graag rust en overzicht in een omgeving die in beweging is. Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met Kubernetes, idealiter met AWS EKS. Je hebt veel gewerkt met AWS en Infrastructure as Code. CI/CD en containers zijn een vertrouwd onderdeel van je werk. Je zorgt voor duidelijkheid in technische processen en afspraken. Ervaring met het bouwen en doorontwikkelen van een softwareproduct is een pré. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je rapporteert aan onze Lead Backend Engineer en bent de vaste sparringpartner van de developers in Product & Technology. Je krijgt veel vertrouwen, eigenaarschap en vrijheid, dus zie je iets wat beter moet, dan pak je het hier meestal gewoon zelf op. Daarbij is er ruimte voor een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Onze doorgroeipaden zijn nog in ontwikkeling, en omdat we tracks verwachten richting lead DevOps, principal engineering en engineering management, ben jij er vroeg bij. Goed basissalaris en een standaard werkweek van 36 uur. Een eindejaarsuitkering van 4% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris en een variabele winstdeling die kan oplopen tot 6% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris. 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar voor bijvoorbeeld extra vakantiedagen. Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering. Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer of een OV-vergoeding, en we bieden een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor medewerkers met een reisafstand van minder dan 10 km of meer dan 60 km hebben we een aangepaste regeling. Hybride werken: 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag, op dinsdag en donderdag. Ruimte om te groeien. In je vak, in je rol, in de organisatie. MEER WETEN? Wij vertellen je graag alles over het team en de rol. Stuur jouw cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog wat vragen? App of bel Nadine op 0628556265. Een referentiecheck en een VOG horen bij het selectieproces. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Stageopdracht Video Content Creator
description: Over Noldus Bij Noldus ontwikkelen we innovatieve software en technologie waarmee onderzoekers wereldwijd menselijk en dierlijk gedrag kunnen bestuderen en analyseren. Onze oplossingen worden gebruikt in uiteenlopende onderzoeksomgevingen, van universiteiten en laboratoria tot ziekenhuizen en bedrijven. We hebben onlangs onze website volledig vernieuwd. Een mooie stap vooruit, maar ons beeldmateriaal is nog niet overal meegegroeid. Daarom zoeken we een creatieve en zelfstandige stagiair die ons helpt om onze producten, software en toepassingen op een moderne en aantrekkelijke manier in beeld te brengen. De stageopdracht Hoe maken we onze innovatieve producten en software visueel aantrekkelijk, begrijpelijk en overtuigend voor onze websitebezoekers? Tijdens deze stage ga je aan de slag met het ontwikkelen en produceren van nieuwe videocontent voor onze website en andere digitale kanalen. Samen met het E-commerce team bepaal je welke onderwerpen en producten we willen uitlichten en hoe we deze het beste kunnen presenteren. Vervolgens vertaal je deze ideeën naar concrete videoconcepten en ga je zelfstandig aan de slag met de uitvoering. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan: • Productvideo’s: laat zien hoe onze producten in de praktijk worden gebruikt en welke mogelijkheden ze bieden. • Softwaredemo’s en screen recordings: maak korte, duidelijke video’s waarin je functionaliteiten en toepassingen van onze software laat zien. • Customer stories: breng in beeld hoe onderzoekers onze oplossingen gebruiken en welke waarde ze toevoegen aan hun onderzoek. • Animaties en motion graphics: gebruik animatie om complexe technologie, processen of functionaliteiten eenvoudig uit te leggen. • Combinaties van bestaand en nieuw beeldmateriaal: ontwikkel creatieve manieren om bestaande content te vernieuwen en aan te vullen met nieuwe beelden. Wat ga je doen? Je krijgt de ruimte om het volledige creatieve proces te doorlopen, van eerste idee tot eindproduct. • Je inventariseert samen met het E-commerce team welke videocontent nodig is en waar de grootste kansen liggen. • Je ontwikkelt creatieve concepten, storyboards en een praktische contentplanning. • Je organiseert en maakt nieuwe video-opnames, zowel van producten als van software in gebruik. • Je maakt screen recordings, animaties en motion graphics waar dit de boodschap versterkt. • Je monteert en bewerkt het materiaal tot professionele video’s die passen bij onze nieuwe huisstijl. • Je zorgt ervoor dat de video’s geschikt zijn voor gebruik op onze website, productpagina’s en andere digitale kanalen. Wat willen we bereiken? Aan het einde van de stage willen we beschikken over een vernieuwde collectie videocontent die: • Onze producten en software duidelijk en aantrekkelijk presenteert. • Websitebezoekers helpt om sneller te begrijpen wat onze oplossingen doen en hoe ze worden gebruikt. • Een moderne, consistente uitstraling heeft die aansluit bij onze nieuwe website en huisstijl. • Op verschillende plekken binnen onze digitale klantreis kan worden ingezet. Naast concrete video’s werk je aan een herkenbare visuele stijl en aanpak, zodat we ook in de toekomst op een consistente manier nieuwe videocontent kunnen ontwikkelen. Wat bieden wij? • Een creatieve stage met veel ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatief. • De mogelijkheid om een project van concept tot eindproduct zelfstandig vorm te geven. • Samenwerking met een enthousiast E-commerce team en verschillende productspecialisten. • Een internationale en innovatieve werkomgeving. • Concrete eindproducten die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt op onze website en digitale kanalen. • Een mooie kans om je portfolio uit te breiden met uiteenlopende videoproducties, animaties en softwaredemo’s. Het eindresultaat Je levert niet alleen een aantal professionele video’s op, maar helpt Noldus ook om een nieuwe standaard neer te zetten voor hoe we onze producten en technologie visueel presenteren. Jouw creativiteit maakt onze innovaties zichtbaar! Wie zoeken wij? We zoeken een creatieve, enthousiaste student die het leuk vindt om ideeën om te zetten in professioneel beeldmateriaal. Je volgt bijvoorbeeld een hbo-opleiding in de richting van Creative Business, Communication & Multimedia Design (CMD), Audiovisuele Media of een vergelijkbare creatieve opleiding. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende: • Je hebt affiniteit met videoproductie, editing en visuele storytelling. • Je kunt werken met tools zoals Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve of vergelijkbare software. • Je vindt het leuk om zowel te filmen als digitaal beeldmateriaal te creëren. • Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op. • Je bent creatief, neemt initiatief en denkt graag mee over hoe iets beter of aantrekkelijker kan. • Je vindt het interessant om complexe software of technologie op een toegankelijke manier uit te leggen. Ervaring met animatie of motion graphics is een pluspunt. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Business Development Manager, Integrator Partners - BENELUX
description: Business Development Manager, Integrator Partners - BENELUX Location: Netherlands – regular travel within BENELUX Start date: Q1 2027 Compensation: €65K - €85K base annually (depending on experience and location) +OTE Employment type: Full-time About DTACT DTACT (Data Transform Act) is a data technology company that helps organizations transform complex information into clear, actionable insights. Founded in 2016, we work with government agencies and enterprises across Europe to solve critical data challenges and support better decision-making in areas such as cybersecurity, defense, intelligence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Built on deep expertise in these domains, we develop innovative solutions that help organizations gain greater visibility, understanding, and control over their data. As a fully remote and internationally distributed company, we combine technical excellence with a collaborative and adaptable way of working. Our mission is simple: to help organizations turn information into action, enabling faster, smarter decisions when they matter most. The Role We're looking for a Business Development Manager (BDM) to make their mark in a brand-new role, with the rare chance to build a function rather than inherit one. As DTACT’s first BDM, you’ll grow our business across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg through system integrators and other integrator partners, shaping how the function is designed and scaled. You’ll be the primary commercial contact for a portfolio of partners, building relationships, agreeing joint business plans and turning partner activity into a steady flow of qualified pipeline and closed deals. Reporting to the Head of Sales BENELUX & South, you’ll work closely with Customer Experience, Product and Pre-sales to make every joint deal a success, with plenty of room to run your own agenda. We’re looking for an enterprising, resourceful self-starter who treats every result as their own and flourishes with real independence. You’re a relationship builder with strong commercial drive who understands how integrators make money and how their sales and delivery teams work. You earn trust quickly with partner leaders and technical teams alike, you’re comfortable working across cultures and languages in BENELUX, and you pair a collaborative attitude with the discipline to hit your number. If you’d rather build something than step into something, we’d love to hear from you. What you'll do Own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of BENELUX integrator partners and be their first point of contact at DTACT. Build and execute joint business plans with clear targets for pipeline, revenue, enablement and customer wins. Identify, qualify and recruit new integrator partners that fit DTACT's market and strategy. Own and accurately forecast the partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue for your portfolio. Co-sell with partners: join customer meetings, support proposals, build joint pipeline and drive complex deals to close, applying deal registration, pricing and margin rules consistently. Make sure partner teams are trained, certified and confident; run regular business reviews; and work with Customer Experience on joint customer delivery. Keep the CRM accurate, report on pipeline and partner performance, and bring partner feedback to Product, Engineering and Marketing. What you'll bring 5+ years of B2B sales or account management in IT, software or cybersecurity, focused on channel, partner or integrator sales. A proven track record of meeting revenue targets through partners and building joint business plans. An existing network or strong knowledge of system integrators and IT partners in BENELUX. Enough technical understanding to hold credible conversations with partner engineers. Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Proactive, hands on approach. Does not need close supervision. Professional English and Dutch; German is a strong plus. Nice to have: experience in cybersecurity, AI or data; building partner programs; or public-sector and tender sales. What's in for you Competitive compensation and equity participation , including an Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP), allowing you to share in DTACT's long-term success. Remote-first flexibility , with the opportunity to work from anywhere within compatible time zones and a schedule that supports both collaboration and personal needs. A trust-based culture built around asynchronous communication , empowering people to work independently while staying connected and aligned across teams. Generous time off , including vacation days and local public holidays to help you rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance. Home office support , including high-quality equipment and a budget to create a productive and comfortable workspace. An international and diverse team , where English is our company language and collaboration spans multiple countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. High-impact work: DTACT helps organizations in and outside the government with mitigating their vulnerabilities and providing alerts to incoming threats. We believe diverse teams build better solutions. DTACT welcomes applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of background or identity. We hire based on skills, experience, and potential, and encourage everyone who meets the role requirements to apply. Please note: Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description: Heel werkend Nederland op de fiets! Dat is de krachtige missie van Lease a Bike, waar we ons dagelijks vol passie voor inzetten. Om onze marktleidende positie verder uit te bouwen en nog meer impact te maken, zijn wij op zoek naar een commercieel gedreven Senior Customer Success Manager. In deze rol krijg jij de verantwoordelijkheid over een portfolio van middelgrote en grote accounts. Je helpt nieuwe klanten succesvol te onboarden en bouwt aan langetermijnrelaties. Een hoge klanttevredenheid en zo veel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen zijn hierbij jouw belangrijkste doelen. Dit doe je natuurlijk niet alleen: je werkt nauw samen in een gedreven team van 6 collega’s. Jouw rol als Customer Success Manager Als Senior Customer Success Manager ben jij de centrale spil tussen jouw klanten en onze interne organisatie. Je schakelt dagelijks met werkgevers en bent intern de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Product & Innovation, Marketing en Customer Support. In jouw portefeuille richt jij je specifiek op bedrijven met 500+ medewerkers. Zodra Sales de samenwerkingsovereenkomst heeft getekend, neem jij het stokje over. Je leidt de implementatie en begeleidt de klant gedurende de gehele levenscyclus. Je adviseert werkgevers bij cruciale beleidskeuzes, helpt hen het platform optimaal in te richten en ontwikkelt gerichte activatiecampagnes. Zo zorg je ervoor dat de fietsregeling ook op de lange termijn top-of-mind blijft en de betrokkenheid van werknemers continu hoog is, met als ultiem doel: zoveel mogelijk werknemers op de fiets krijgen! Daarnaast ben je analytisch ijzersterk. Je gebruikt data om jouw klantsegment grondig te analyseren, ontdekt waar kansen liggen en weet creatieve ideeën om te zetten in concrete acties en resultaat. Wat vragen we van jou? Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding; Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in Customer Success of Accountmanagement; Aantoonbare ervaring met het begeleiden van implementatietrajecten, relatiebeheer en het schrijven van accountplannen; Commercieel ingesteld en communicatief ijzersterk: je doorgrondt klantbehoeften snel en vertaalt deze naar effectieve actieplannen; Een hoge mate van zelfstandigheid en het vermogen om projecten met diverse stakeholders of complexe vraagstukken te leiden; Een sterk probleemoplossend en analytisch vermogen met focus op het uitbouwen van duurzame klantrelaties; Je kunt goed plannen, bewaart het overzicht en gaat gestructureerd te werk; Een flexibele en hands-on mentaliteit die past bij een snelgroeiende marktleider; Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en schrift; Wat bieden wij?  Naast een uitdagende rol met veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en een grote impact op de verdere groei van Lease a Bike bieden wij nog veel meer: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 3.950,- en € 4.450.  8% vakantiegeld, een bonusregeling van 10% én een jaarlijkse winstuitkering; Een jaarlijkse toekenning van 20 wettelijke verlofdagen, 5 bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen en 6 ATV-dagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband; Een gloednieuwe leasefiets naar keuze (Pon-merk) met een maandelijkse werkgeversbijdrage; Een reiskostenvergoeding of Shuttel-kaart voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor reist; Focus op ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je continu te blijven ontwikkelen via onder andere onze Winter- en Summerlabstrainingen; Een gezonde lunch op kantoor in Amersfoort tegen een kleine bijdrage; Een thuiswerkplek door ons gefaciliteerd met de mogelijkheid voor een netto thuiswerkvergoeding voor als je af en toe thuis wil werken; Een collectieve Zorgverzekering bij ONVZ of Zilveren Kruis met een werkgeversbijdrage; Én, last but not least, een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling bij het Pon Pensioenfonds van 30% waarbij Lease a Bike 20% bijdraagt. Over de organisatie Lease a Bike is ontstaan vanuit liefde voor mensen en fietsen. Voor ons is fietsen niet zomaar een manier van vervoer. Voor ons is fietsen een ‘way of life’. Fietsen is goed voor je gezondheid. Goed voor je portemonnee. Goed voor de wereld. Anderen stimuleren om de fiets te pakken, daar gaan wij voor! Wil jij een bijdrage leveren aan een duurzamere wereld, waarbij vitaliteit en fun hand in hand gaan? Join the ride en draag bij aan de verwezenlijking van onze missie. Als scale-up is Lease a Bike onderdeel van mobiliteitsprovider Bike Mobility Services Group (Pon)! Define customer segments, lifecycle stages, journey maps, messaging, and campaign playbooks that can be adapted for EMEA audiences. Partner with Customer Success and Customer Enablement to promote onboarding, education, product engagement, and other programs that help customers achieve meaningful outcomes. Create signal-based campaigns tied to customer needs, product usage, account changes, renewal timing, and expansion fit. Route qualified opportunities to the appropriate Customer Success Managers and account executives. raw.title: Customer Marketing Manager, EMEA
raw.description:
Horizon3.ai is seeking a customer-focused, data-driven Customer Marketing Manager to build engagement, adoption, retention, expansion, and advocacy across our EMEA customer base. You will create programs that help customers realize more value from Horizon3, strengthen customer relationships, and turn successful outcomes into credible customer proof.

This role brings together customer lifecycle marketing and customer advocacy. You will develop regional customer communications and campaigns while building a repeatable advocacy engine across customer stories, references, third-party reviews, speakers, and other strategic opportunities. You will work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, and the broader Marketing team to turn customer needs and business priorities into useful, measurable programs.

The ideal candidate is both a strategic planner and a hands-on operator. You can build trust with customers, coordinate complex projects across teams and markets, use data to improve programs, and make it straightforward for customers to participate.

What you will do

Customer lifecycle marketing

  • Plan and execute customer marketing programs across onboarding, activation, adoption, engagement, retention, renewal support, and expansion.

  • Define customer segments, lifecycle stages, journey maps, messaging, and campaign playbooks that can be adapted for EMEA audiences.

  • Partner with Customer Success and Customer Enablement to promote onboarding, education, product engagement, and other programs that help customers achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Develop proactive re-engagement programs for at-risk or under-engaged accounts using customer health, product usage, support, engagement, and renewal signals.

  • Create signal-based campaigns tied to customer needs, product usage, account changes, renewal timing, and expansion fit. Route qualified opportunities to the appropriate Customer Success Managers and account executives.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product to translate customer feedback into product communications, release messaging, educational content, and lifecycle campaigns.

  • Equip Sales and Customer Success with customer-centric messaging, adoption resources, executive business review materials, playbooks, and clear follow-up paths.

Customer advocacy and proof

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of EMEA customer advocates based on customer outcomes, engagement, use cases, and willingness to participate.

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers and account teams to identify customers for case studies, video testimonials, customer quotes, social content, references, and events.

  • Manage customer participation from outreach through briefing, approvals, production, publication, and follow-up. Coordinate logo rights, quotes, and other customer permissions with the appropriate internal teams.

  • Create and manage a practical customer reference program that supports sales opportunities, renewals, expansions, and strategic marketing needs. Maintain an organized reference pool and manage requests from intake and matching through scheduling, follow-up, and recognition.

  • Own day-to-day Peerbound administration and adoption, including customer profiles, advocacy requests, reference activity, permissions, and reporting. Help Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success use the platform consistently and make fuller use of its capabilities.

  • Develop and execute a focused third-party review strategy across relevant platforms, such as G2 and Gartner Peer Insights. Coordinate authentic customer outreach and track review volume, ratings, sentiment, category placement, competitor positioning, and progress against award criteria.

  • Maintain a qualified pipeline of customer speakers for webinars, user groups, events, panels, and other marketing programs. Confirm speakers early enough to include them in event promotions, landing pages, emails, and social campaigns, and manage briefing, preparation, logistics, approvals, and follow-up.

  • Own the customer invitation process for Customer Advisory Board opportunities and support customer recruitment for analyst interviews, research, awards, and other strategic initiatives.

  • Work with Content, Product Marketing, Social, Events, Communications, Analyst Relations, and Creative to elevate customers alongside the Horizon3.ai brand and turn customer outcomes into reusable marketing assets.

Program operations and measurement

  • Build annual and quarterly customer marketing plans for EMEA, manage budgets and resources, and lead cross-functional execution.

  • Work with Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success Operations to improve segmentation, data quality, trigger detection, nurture, automation, attribution, and reporting.

  • Establish dashboards and operating rhythms that connect program engagement to adoption, customer advocacy, renewal health, retention, expansion pipeline, and influenced revenue.

  • Define success measures, analyze results, identify opportunities to improve, and iterate on program strategy, messaging, and execution.

  • Communicate timelines, owners, status, risks, and next steps clearly across teams. Create practical templates, trackers, and workflows that make customer marketing easier to execute and scale.

What you bring

  • 7+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, customer advocacy, customer success enablement, or a related discipline.

  • Experience building customer journeys and programs across adoption, engagement, retention, renewal, expansion, or advocacy.

  • A track record of managing customer stories, references, reviews, speakers, or other advocacy programs, ideally alongside lifecycle marketing responsibilities.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and confidence communicating with customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience partnering with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Marketing Operations, and Revenue Operations.

  • Strong project management and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple programs and deadlines across teams and markets.

  • Analytical and operational skills, including the ability to connect customer behavior and program performance to business outcomes.

title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)
description: Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights. At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action. About the role As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information. You will: support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities; own and maintain the data model analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights; investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers; build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis; use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use; investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting; help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working; contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes; translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights. An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights. Your development in data Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to: contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals; design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible; integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption); manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture; apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA; map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions; work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques; document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability. This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control. Collaboration & positioning You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective. Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe. The role is based at our head office in Almere. HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected. What you bring We are looking for someone who is analytical, energetic and curious. You enjoy getting to the bottom of a question rather than simply producing a report. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do and how the underlying data can provide better insights. You bring: willingness to learn around 3–5 years of relevant work experience, for example as a big 4 auditor, Finance Analyst, Data Analyst or Junior Business Controller; solid knowledge of finance and accounting, preferably gained through an education in Accountancy, Finance & Control, Business Information Management, Data Analytics); experience with or a strong interest in Power BI; strong analytical skills; the ability to think conceptually about data, reporting and data models; a curious and proactive approach to solving problems; the confidence to ask questions and challenge existing ways of working; an energetic mindset and the drive to learn and improve; a genuine eagerness to learn and to keep developing yourself, both in finance and in data; fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is desirable. experience with AI tools, such as Copilot. Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit What we offer This is a role where you can build a strong foundation in modern Business Control while developing further in data and analytics. You will not only work with existing reports and figures, but also have the opportunity to improve how information is structured, analysed and used. You can expect: a monthly salary between €4.000 and €5.200 (excluding holiday allowance), depending on your experience. an annual on-target bonus of 10% of your gross annual salary;  full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave;  a pension scheme;  a commuting allowance;  a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued; the opportunity to grow towards a broader Business Controller role as your knowledge, experience and responsibilities develop; structured coaching by our Data Specialist to develop your data skills alongside your finance role; a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks. We are HG HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products. We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems. HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance. We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact. HG does what it promises. Do you have any questions? Our colleague Ilse de Groot, Corporate Recruiter, will be happy to answer any questions. You can contact her at Would you like to apply for the junior business controller position at HG? You can apply directly by uploading your CV. We aim to respond within 5 working days. Acquisition in response to this vacancy is not appreciated. title: HR-Stagiair(e)
description: Als HR‑Stagiair(e) draai je bij ons mee in het HR‑team en krijg je de kans om veel te leren, met een duidelijke focus op Learning & Development. Je werkt mee aan verschillende HR- en L&D‑activiteiten en krijgt daarnaast de ruimte om je stage zelf vorm te geven en te ontdekken welke andere HR‑onderwerpen jou aanspreken. Zo doe je brede praktijkervaring op in een omgeving waar veel gebeurt en waar je actief kunt bijdragen. Jouw stage: Je werkt mee in ons team van 10 HR‑professionals met expertise in o.a. onboarding, L&D, verzuim, recruitment, employer branding en HR‑advies. Je krijgt veel vrijheid én goede begeleiding om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Waar draag je aan bij? Het versterken van vaardigheden en ontwikkeling binnen de organisatie door mee te werken aan L&D‑projecten. Het soepel laten verlopen van soft skills trainingen, door ondersteuning bij voorbereiding, communicatie en coördinatie. De verbetering van HR‑processen door het initiëren en uitvoeren van eigen HR‑projecten (bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van onboarding, recruitment of procesoptimalisatie). Events rondom arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, workshops rond duurzame inzetbaarheid en onboardingsactiviteiten. Een correcte en overzichtelijke HR‑administratie, zoals het opstellen van contracten, brieven en personele mutaties. Continue verbetering binnen HR door actieve deelname aan HR‑overleggen en het meedenken over verbeteringen. Onze organisatie beweegt snel: er gebeurt veel en geen week is hetzelfde. Dat biedt enorm veel leerkansen, maar vraagt ook dat jij zelf richting geeft aan je stage en je weg vindt in een dynamische omgeving. Je krijgt van ons goede begeleiding, maar het is aan jou om kansen te zien en initiatief te tonen. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken een stagiair(e) die: Een hbo‑opleiding HRM volgt (3e of 4e jaar) en stage wil lopen vanaf februari 2027. Beschikbaar is voor 4 of 5 dagen per week. Geïnteresseerd is in Learning & Development. Sterk is in Nederlands en goed overweg kan met Engels. Nauwkeurig werkt, durft te vragen en zelfstandig durft te handelen. Het leuk vindt om in een dynamische omgeving te werken waar veel gebeurt. Wij bieden: Stageplek per september 2026 voor 32-40 uur per week. Begeleiding van ervaren HR-professionals. Stagevergoeding van € 650,- per maand op basis van 40 uur. Meedoen met ons Be-Fit programma; wekelijks sporten met collega’s. Ook gewoon een superleuke tijd! Over Benchmark Benchmark in Almelo maakt onderdeel uit van de multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., een beursgenoteerde onderneming op het gebied van het vervaardigen van elektronica en het leveren van diensten richting original equipment manufacturers (OEM’s). Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met productie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd. Wereldwijd heeft Benchmark Electronics Inc. momenteel 23 vestigingen. Op onze vestiging in Almelo werken we samen met zo’n 675 collega’s. Interesse? Benchmark wil vooruit, samen met jou als HR-Stagiair(e)! Ben je op zoek naar meer informatie? Neem dan contact op met Stan Broenink via Het verstrekken van een VOG is een vast onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure bij Benchmark. Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld. description: Who are we? We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging. Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive. As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in. Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow. About the role Aquablu's products run Android in more places than your pocket. Our dispensing systems ship with Android-powered on-device software that hundreds of thousands of people touch every day, and our mobile apps put hydration in users' hands. As our Android Engineer, you work across that whole surface. Your main arena is on-device: the software running on the hardware itself, where Android meets the physical world. Screens people tap on a machine, software that talks to firmware, updates that roll out to hundreds of deployed systems in the field. Alongside that, you contribute to our mobile development where the products need it. Few Android roles give you this range. This is a hands-on engineering role in a small, fast team. You own features end to end and deliver them reliably, reaching out to your manager when support is needed to unblock you. You build with AI agents as your default collaborator, you work cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and product, proactively identifying and reaching out to key players that can help filling any gaps. This role reports into our Head of Digital Product, and is part of Aquablu’s Software & Intelligence Engineering team. What You'll Build & Own On-device Android software: Features on the user-facing software running on our dispensing systems — UI, device behaviour, and the integration layer where software meets hardware. You own your features end to end. Fleet-ready releases: Contribute to releases that update reliably across hundreds of deployed devices in the field, where a broken release means a technician visit. The riskiest releases get a second pair of senior eyes — and you learn what makes them safe. Hardware & firmware integration: Work with embedded and firmware engineers to define and implement serial APIs (UART), that expose device state and trigger mechanical actions. Mobile contribution: Support Android development on our consumer app where the roadmap needs it. AI-native development: Build with AI agents every day and keep pushing what that lets you ship. What You Bring Solid Android engineering experience: A minimum of 3-5 years building and shipping Android apps in Kotlin, with a solid grasp of the platform (lifecycle, concurrency). You should be able to judge which Android patterns fit a non-standard system, and to design features that contribute to a scalable, reliable system. Curiosity for Android beyond the traditional mobile world: kiosk, embedded, or AOSP work is a strong plus. Pragmatic problem solver who’s comfortable working outside of familiar mobile patterns. Work independently on well-scoped tasks. When scope is unclear, flag it, reach out to the right people, and get the answers and support you need to unblock yourself. Plan the work, communicate progress early, and deliver end to end. AI-native coding is how you work. You build with AI agents daily, you have a sharp setup, and your output shows it.
