title: Senior Data Engineer
description: Everfield: Senior Data Engineer The Company Everfield is a platform with a mission in acquiring, building, and operating vertical market and specialist software companies, focused on European businesses. We invest in and provide support and best practices to software companies in order for them to live up to their full potential by offering a very established approach to promote growth. Everfield is looking to be the leader in European Vertical and specialist software solutions across myriad niche industries who provide mission-critical applications, service, and support to their clients. Everfield seeks to deliver innovation and growth to its acquired companies by providing best practices and operational support to help identify opportunities and install proven methodologies to accelerate customer and market share. Everfield is located throughout Europe, with offices in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, France, Poland, Spain, and Latvia. The Position As a Senior Data Engineer at Everfield, you will leverage your expertise and experience to: Continuously improve scalability and stability of our data platform called the Lakehouse Create new data pipeline solutions on various data sources (ERP, CRMs, etc.) Design and model data in a common data model and Kimball-style dimensional models, making it ready for consumption in Power BI and other tools Further developing Lakehouse Lumen , our MCP server that makes Lakehouse data available to Claude for end users Improve existing solutions to improve value add for various stakeholders You’ll be working as part of the Business Intelligence (BI) team. Currently the team consists of a Lead Data Engineer, three Data Analysts and a hands-on team lead. The BI team creates value for various stakeholders (CEO, Finance, COO, Sales, Marketing, and Everfield’sportfolio companies), by creating insights, delivering analysis, automating reporting processes and improving data quality. The team builds pipelines with Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics to ingest the data into our data platform, uses Azure Databricks for data transformation, Power BI for data visualization and Azure Container Apps to expose data via a MCP server to Claude. For most solutions, the team uses Python and SQL . For many use cases we work in an agentic way, using Claude to plan and implement them. To support this, we built the "Lakehouse DevKit". A set of agents and skills that we plan to keep extending and improving. This role is hybrid from Amsterdam area. Responsibilities Adhere to the DevOps methodology by: Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer and Team Lead to plan and prioritize tasks. Develop data pipelines in Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics, along with data ingestion and process scripts using PySpark and Pandas, while managing version control through Git. Improve and extend the MCP server that provides data to Claude. Create unit tests, test your own work and review work of colleagues (via Pull Requests), to ensure quality control. Extend the Lakehouse DevKit to support and accelerate agentic development workflows. Enhance and maintain deployment pipelines to facilitate smooth releases to end users. Monitor the data platform (including data pipelines, ingestion/processing jobs, and alerts), while continuously improving logging and monitoring practices. Ideal Candidate Profile Hard Skills Required: 3+ year of experience as Data Engineer , and 5+ years of professional experience within Data or related fields. Expert in PySpark and Pandas for data processing. Experience with Databricks for advanced analytics. Strong knowledge of SQL and data modeling (especially star schema). Familiarity with financial systems (ERP, NetSuite, SAP) and/or experience with CRM systems and customer data . Nice to have: Experience with Claude Code (agents, skills) Knowledge of Power Query and Power BI for data visualization. Experience deploying Azure resources like Azure Container Apps . Soft Skills Independent Worker : Ability to operate autonomously while contributing effectively to team goals. Business Acumen : Strong understanding of business and economic principles, with an ability to apply them in a data context. Analytical Mindset : Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills. Collaborative : Actively seeks alignment with team members and participates in planning sessions. Quality-Focused : Committed to reviewing both your own work and that of others to maintain high standards. Strategic Planner : Consider alternative solutions and refine features before implementation. Purpose-Driven : Demonstrates a deep understanding of tasks, ensuring they align with business objectives. What’s in it for you? Grow your career in a fast-paced and growing organization. Enable growth by building a robust and scalable data platform. Working with the latest Data Engineering & Data Modeling technologies. Long term career opportunities. Working from home for up to 4 days per week. Flexible work environment with offices around Europe (Netherlands, UK, Spain, France, Poland, Germany). Continue the Conversation Interested? description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Mavericks Wanted</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare&nbsp;disease, and&nbsp;develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span>&nbsp;<br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll&nbsp;ask&nbsp;"why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical &amp; thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><h3><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></h3> <p>The Senior Director, Head of Quality <span style="font-size: inherit;">&amp; Responsible Person</span> for Encaleret, International, leads the quality organization of BridgeBio Pharma Europe B.V. and reports to Senior Vice President Quality. As the Responsible Person, the role carries personal accountability under EU GDP for the entity's distribution activities: release for distribution, recalls, and products that are authentic, correctly stored and transported, and traceable. The role is independent of Commercial Operations, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, with an unrestricted right of escalation to the entity's full board. She/he leads and develops the entity's quality team, maintains the entity's quality management system, developed with the affiliate quality leads from existing BridgeBio frameworks, and leads WDA licensing, inspection readiness and subsequent MIA readiness, if needed.</p> <h3><strong><u>Responsibilities</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as the named Responsible Person on the WDA: release for distribution, recall decisions, and GDP compliance of the entity&nbsp;</li> <li>Take final disposition decision on returned, rejected, recalled or potentially falsified products (an RP decision under GDP), in consultation with BridgeBio's Global Quality Management</li> <li>Support and coordinate returns, rejections, suspected falsified products and recall operations</li> <li>Approve return to saleable stock</li> <li>Ensure that customers are entitled to receive the products prior to shipment</li> <li>Ensure the WDA registration remains current with the commercial supply chain setup</li> <li>Ensure the accuracy of quality records and that GDP requirements are implemented and maintained in the quality management system, as required for the WDA license</li> <li>Lead the WDA application and IGJ inspection readiness&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensure data integrity and own the entity's internal audit (self-inspection) program</li> <li>Own the GDP quality agreement matrix: contract service providers, 3PLs, distributors and intercompany interfaces&nbsp;</li> <li>Review and write standard operating procedures in BridgeBio’s document management system in accordance with the GDP requirements</li> <li>Ensure there is a training program for BridgeBio staff working under GDP and ensure that the relevant staff members are trained on GDP</li> <li>Participate in GDP vendor qualification program</li> <li>Perform quality review of assigned quality events such as deviations, change controls, supplier notifications</li> <li>Perform distribution release for finished goods received from the contract manufacturing organization, which can include review of temperature, shipping and receiving documentation&nbsp;</li> <li>Be responsible for and be directly involved in product complaints from the EU and ROW markets</li> <li>Provide GDP and QA related support and intelligence</li> <li>Be available and reachable 24/7&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Other QA/Quality Person related responsibilities</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Build, lead and develop the entity's quality team: deputy RP, QA compliance/QMS, and QA operations/GDP; and QP, if needed</li> <li>Implement and maintain the entity's GDP-compliant quality management system by adopting existing BridgeBio quality frameworks, adapted to the entity's license requirements</li> <li>Work closely with the affiliate quality leads to resolve quality issues and keep the intercompany interfaces effective</li> <li>Prepare subsequent MIA readiness (QP recruitment, import, API GMP verification, and batch-certification processes), if needed&nbsp;</li> <li>Assist in updating CMC sections of regulatory and quality documents as needed&nbsp;</li> <li>Participate in regulatory inspections&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Participate in internal and external project team meetings&nbsp;</li> <li>Write and review governing procedure (e.g., SOPs, WIs, etc.), where necessary&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Other duties as assigned&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Where You’ll Work&nbsp;</u></strong></h3> <p>This is a Netherlands-based role that will require 30% travel.</p> <h3><strong><u>Who You Are</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years in pharmaceutical quality, including significant GDP / distribution quality experience; prior appointment as (or eligibility to be) a Responsible Person strongly preferred&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience leading regulatory inspections with EU competent authorities (IGJ preferred)&nbsp;</li> <li>Prior experience of managing third party vendors (CMOs, CTLs, 3PLs, etc.)</li> <li>Prior relevant knowledge and experience related to the distribution of medical products&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong understanding of supply chain concepts, supplier management, inventory&nbsp;management&nbsp;</li> <li>Extensive knowledge of US/EU GMPs /GDPs and associated guidance&nbsp;</li> <li>Working in a highly regulated environment&nbsp;</li> <li>Proven leadership of quality teams; experience building quality functions or systems&nbsp;</li> <li>BS/MS degree preferably in operations, science, pharmacy</li> <li>Documented GDP training and the education and experience to be accepted as Responsible Person by the Dutch authorities (Farmatec/IGJ)</li> </ul> <h3><strong><u>Skills</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Understanding the EU and particularly IGJ regulations in relation to the wholesale distribution of medicines&nbsp;</li> <li>Fluent in English language; written/spoken in Dutch language, preferred&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong planning and time management skills with ability to prioritize workload&nbsp;</li> <li>Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail&nbsp;</li> <li>Basic understanding of data concepts and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems e.g., SAP&nbsp;</li> <li>Ready to embrace company core values and diverse corporate culture&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><u>Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>We have high expectations for our team members</li> <li>We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return</li> <li>Market leading compensationHybrid work model - we value your flexibility in how you work, but encourage time in the office to strengthen our culture, collaboration, and sense of community</li> <li>We provide career development through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs</li> <li>We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location.&nbsp; <span data-contrast="auto">We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.</span></strong></p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">For BridgeBio title: Dutch speaking Support Specialist
description: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place! As part of Lightspeed’s Support team, you will be the first point of contact for our customers who need assistance, helping with a wide variety of requests all the way from general education to hardware/software investigation and everything in between.
